faqs.question: Is IIM Ahmedabad hard to get?
faqs.answer:
IIM Ahmedabad admissions is based on entrance. Therefore, candidates must qualify the eligibility criteria and secure valid scores in CAT entrance exams. Moreoever, candidates ae required to apply for admission through the official website of IIMA. The percentile of CAT for IIM Ahmedabad reached up to 99.6 in the past years which shows how rigorous it is for a student to get admission to this Institute. Candidates are shortlisted for these programmes based on course-specific entrance exams, followed by shortlisting processes which generally comprise a Personal Interview (PI) round.
To conclude, seeking admission to IIM Ahmedabad is challenging but not difficult.

faqs.question: What is the highest package offered during IIM Ahmedabad placements?
faqs.answer: The overall highest package recorded during IIM Ahmedabad PGP placements 2025 was INR 110 LPA. In PGP FABM and PGPX courses, the highest salary offered in 2025 was 41.83 LPA and 76.5 LPA.

faqs.question: Does IIM Ahmedabad have 100% placements?
faqs.answer: In PGP FABM courses, 100% placements was recorded during the placement drive 2025 and 2024 as well. In PGPX course, 1 student was unplaced in 2025 as per the audited report. During the PGP placements 2025, 395 students were placed and 11 students opted out from placements out of total 406 eligible students. PGP placement rate in 2025 was 100%.

faqs.question: Which sector hires the maximum number of students during IIM Ahmedabad placement drive?
faqs.answer: Consulting was the top recruiting sector during PGP, PGP FABM, PGPX placements 2025 at IIM Ahmedabad. The numbers of offers made by Consulting to the students of these courses were 156, 15 and 32.

college_info.intro:
MBA is the flagship programme offered by IIMA. MBA students are taught to make the right decisions in the face of difficult business challenges. They are trained through case method courses, FIELD projects, etc. MBA is taught by expert faculty members. The college provides global exposure to students through student exchange programmes.
The Institute offers an MBA on the basis of the CAT entrance exam and a minimum aggregate of 50% in graduation. For CAT 2025 eligibility, candidates must obtain a bachelor's degree with a professional degree in CA/ CS/ ICWA (CMA)/ FIAI with a minimum percentage.
IIMA offers 385 seats in total for PGP admissions through CAT. Furthermore, there is no age limit to appear for the CAT examination. Moreover, the cost of an MBA at IIM Ahmedabad includes tuition fees ranging from INR 12 Lakh to INR 25 Lakh, depending on the specialisation opted for.
The Institute offers an MBA for a duration of 16 months to 2 years. MBA students can plan their careers in Management Consulting and various other fields. IIM Ahmedabad's MBA students can become Marketing Managers, Business Analysts, and Investment Bankers, and can take up various other job roles.

overview_faqs.question: Is studying at IIM Ahmedabad expensive?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, IIM Ahmedabad is certainly costly. IIM Ahmedabad total fees ranges between INR 64,000 and INR 33 lakh. The fees vary depending on the programme and specialisation selected by the students. The fee for certain programmes certainly falls in the higher end of the spectrum. Students need to pay INR 25 lakh as IIM Ahmedabad MBA fee. However, considering the fact that IIMA is one of the top-rate IIMs and limitless oppurtunities students can experience at the institute, it might be considered a worthwile investment. Further, the institute also offers financial aid to its students.

overview_faqs.question: Why do IIMs charge high fees even though it is a government institution?
overview_faqs.answer: Although IIMs are government institute, most IIMs are self reliant and do no depend on government for funding. Hence to attract quality professors they need to charge higher fee. Also, never in the history of IIMs any student has dropped out because of financial reasons. There are several scholarships available for students in need.

placement_data.title: IIM Ahmedabad Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: 395 students were placed from the PGP batch of 406 eligible students during IIM Ahmedabad placements 2025. 11 PGP students opted out from the placement process. 178 companies visited the campus and offered around 261 roles during IIM A placement 2025 for the PGP course. BCG followed by Accenture Strategy, American Express Bain & Co and McKinsey & Company made the most number of offers . BCG and Accenture made 35 and 31 offers whereas Bain made 17 offers. Finance , General Management and Strategy functions witnessed increase of 13.7%, 5% and 33% in the number of net offers made. The highest and median package recorded during IIM Ahmedabad PGP placement 2025 was INR 110 LPA and 34.53 LPA (Maximum Earning Potential).

In PGP FABM program , out of 45 eligible students , 1 student opted out of the placement drive and 44 students were placed in 2025 . Placement rate recorded for PGP FABM was 100% . The batch received 12 PPOs and 3 lateral offers. The highest and median package received by PGP FABM students during the placement drive 2025 was INR 41.83 LPA and 20.04 LPA (Maximum Earning Potential).

PGPX placements were also good in 2025 . The highest and median salary received during PGPX placements 2025 was INR 76.5 LPA and 34.41 LPA . Out of 158 eligible students , 138 students opted for placements and 137 students were placed in 2025. 170 companies participated and made more than 150 offers to the PGPX batch. Out of the total companies participated, 80 were new recruiters .

overview.text: IIM Ahmedabad Campus is built in the heart of the city. It is spread over 102 acres and is tastefully designed with extensive green spaces. IIMA campus represents the institute’s educational philosophy – critical thinking, orientation to real life, and active intellectual self-reliance. Work on the IIM Ahmedabad campus began in 1962 and was carried out by renowned architect, Louis Kahn. He designed the campus with sustainability in mind. Moreover, the campus has something for everyone with gardens, trails, and playgrounds to sports facilities and meditation nooks and cafes. Read on to learn more about the IIMA campus, hostel, student life, and more.

hostel.description: IIM- A has 25 student dormitories with a total capacity to hold about 740 occupants. Apart from the dormitories, there are separate housing facilities available for married candidates. The dorms have ten single rooms on each floor arranged around a stairway and a tearoom. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals are served. The rooms are fully furnished including a telephone connection. The dorms also have a T.V., washing machine and refrigerator.
facilities: Dorms with TV, washing machine, refrigerator

library.description: IIM Ahmedabad Vikram Sarabhai Library has a collection of over 1,94,704 books, 19815 online and 146 print journals, 46,024 bound volumes, 2624 working papers, 349 thesis, 2187 student's project reports. It offers access to current, global and relevant information in various formats (print & non-print) to serve the information needs of the academic fraternity. The strength of the library is its digital collection of 71 databases, accessible from any networked computer within the campus which provides scholarly, company and industry information. Open carrels are provided in the stack area for individual study. IIMA library provides specialized tools like EBSCO Discovery. It also provides RemoteXS facility to current students and faculty.

faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.
faqs.question: Q: Can an average student get into an IIM?

faqs.answer: IIM Bangalore considers two kinds of CAT scores for MBA admission - Qualifying and Final score. Qualifying CAT score is the minimum sectional and overall CAT score used to shortlist students for the Analytical Writing Test (AWT) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. Candidates above minimum cutoffs in the sectional percentile ranks, the overall percentile rank and having a positive (greater than zero) raw score in all sections of CAT are considered for the next stage. The final CAT score is cutoffs are the basis of which the candidates are called for final selection after the AWT and PI rounds are over.

course_faqs.question: Why choose IIM Bangalore executive MBA course?
course_faqs.answer: With an average package of INR 33.07 LPA and an NIRF ranking of 2 for its Management courses, E-MBA from IIMs is considered one of the best choices for working professionals who want to improve their knowledge and education level by pursuing a Management degree. Additionally, IIM Bangalore has seen an improving trend in the average package over the years. In 2022, the average package stood at INR 30.09 LPA and INR 26.08 LPA in 2021.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee of IIM Bangalore?
overview_faqs.answer: IIM Bangalore Hostel fees are INR 80,000 for a single student and INR 3.76 lakh for family accommodation. IIM Bangalore students are provided with accommodation on campus in a well-appointed single room in the hostels. IIM-B has 16 hostel blocks, one executive block, and executive accommodation at the Management Development Centre, popularly known as MDC. Twenty-four-hour Internet connectivity, fully automatic washing machines, a hair salon, a music room, a student-run library, a recreation room, and a store on the hostel premises are standard features. Laundry and ironing services, an intercom facility, and a guest room facility for visitors are also provided.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA course at IIM Bangalore?
overview_faqs.answer: The IIM Bangalore fees for the MBA course is INR 12.5 Lacs - INR 24.5 lakh. The accepted entrance exam for admission to the IIM Bangalore is CAT. Candidates willing to get admission must first register for the CAT exam. Then, with valid scores apply on the official website of the college. Pay the fee in time to avoid late fee submission charges.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth pursuing MBA at IIM Bangalore?
overview_faqs.answer: IIM Bangalore flagship course is MBA, which is available across 10 electives, including Decision Sciences, Economics and Social Sciences, and Entrepreneurship among others. The duration of the courses ranges from 2 years to 5 years. Pursuing this course means that students will have a secured future. MBA students can become Managers, or can go for various other job profiles.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration in Digital Business and Entrepreneurship BBA (DBE) - Batch of 2028

content.Learning Experience: The course is very relevant to our day-to-day life and the industry's needs. individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The best IIM in India, with great industrial exposure.

content.Placements: Placements were totally amazing, and I was quite satisfied with the placements via IIM Bangalore. Students got the best industrial exposure here in Bangalore. admission_overview.title: IIM Bangalore Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: Looking to enrol on a Master's programme in the field of Management? Then IIM Bangalore is the answer for you if you're someone on a search for experiencing and learning a great many things in addition to gaining a degree from a prestigious institute. IIM Bangalore admissions 2026 are completely entrance-based. The institute offers MBA, Executive MBA, and other courses at PG, doctoral and certificate level courses in the field of Management. Candidates seeking admission at IIM Bangalore need to appear for national-level or college-level entrance exams, according to the selected course. Admission to the flagship course, i.e.IIM Bangalore MBA is based on a valid score in the CAT exam, followed by a Personal Interview (PI) and Written Ability Test (WAT) round. placement_data.title: IIM Bangalore Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The average and median package offered during IIM Bangalore placements 2025 for PGP and PGPBA programs stood at INR 34.88 LPA and INR 32.61 LPA , respectively. A total of 660 offers were made and 177 companies visited the campus in 2025. For EPGP program, average and median package received during placements 2025 was INR 35.5 LPA and INR 33.1 LPA . Further, 72 offers were made to the batch of 82 EPGP students in 2025 during IIM Bangalore placement.

A total of 660 offers were made to the PGP batch of 602 students. Out of the total offers, 22 were international offers. 177 companies visited the campus in 2025. Companies such as Accenture Strategy, BCG and TCS Management Consulting made 75, 25 and 24 offers, respectively. Consulting sector emerged as the top recruiting sector with 41% placement distribution

A total of 31 companies visited and 72 offers were made to batch of 82 students. Further, 3 students opted out of placement in 2025. Consulting sector was the top sector with 44% placement distribution. Top recruiters such as Accenture S&C and EY made 7 offers each whereas Samsung made 5 offers during EPGP placements 2025.

description: IIM Bangalore cutoff 2024 is available on this page for MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the IIM Bangalore CAT cutoff 2024 across different courses and categories. Further updates related to CAT 2025 are provided below:

The IIM Bangalore cut off 2024 for PG courses MBA/PGDM (4 courses) is based on CAT scores. The institute releases two types of CAT cutoffs, namely the qualifying CAT cutoff and the final CAT cutoff. Securing a minimum qualifying cutoff just means that the candidate will be eligible for the WAT-PI round of IIM Bangalore admission. Also, the IIM Bangalore final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff. The qualifying cutoffs for IIMs mostly remain the same every year.

IIM Bangalore admission 2025 is a two-step process. In the first step, candidates with valid CAT 2024 are shortlisted for the Writing Ability Test (WAT) and Personal Interview (PI). Candidates above minimum cutoffs in the sectional percentile ranks, the overall percentile rank, and having a positive (greater than zero) raw score in all sections of CAT 2024 are to be considered for the next stage of IIM Bangalore admissions. reviews.review_text: The course is very relevant to our day-to-day life and the industry's needs. We get to learn many creative subjects like accounts, coding, building a venture from 250, and UI/UX. The level of skills and guidance that is provided here is unimaginable. It provides you with an upper edge over a normal BBA, where it is only about the old-school rigorous subjects.

reviews.review_text: Best-in-class infrastructure and amazing amenities were provided by the college. The campus life at IIM Bangalore was amazing, with youth fests, fairs, and cultural programs organized by the college on a regular basis. Sports facilities and opportunities were given to students, and the food quality in the mess and canteen was average.

Hostel infrastructure includes very sound facilities, including 2 BHK rooms, full-time Wi-Fi, laundry, and security facilities.

Wi-Fi, labs, canteen, sports complex, auditoriums, halls, etc., are available on the campus. The hostel facility is also good. The food in the mess is good to eat. The rooms are furnished and big enough.

All classes provide digital cameras. The hostel room was available, and I lived in block A. The hostel maid took good care of the students.

reviews.review_heading: This is one of the best MBA colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: This college provides free Wi-Fi, laboratories, and 24X7 library. The internships are great to understand what field is the best for students, and they can also earn money while they are ATIT. The campus library is one of the best features of this college, and as a voracious reader, I spend the majority of my time there.

reviews.review_text: IIM Bangalore has 100 acre large beautiful campus. All the students are provided hostel facilities. Everyone is given single room with shared washrooms. Campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Mess food is very good if you compare to any other college campus. College has good sports infrastructure. We also have a modern finance lab having Bloomberg and Reuters terminals. Library is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Experience is worth for lifetime.
reviews.review_text: Everyone gets individual rooms which include all the amenities. Complete campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Library has more than sufficient resources. Library can be accessed even from remote location. Library resources include many useful databases, research papers, books and journals.

reviews.review_heading: Absolute value for money. Every student can have holistic learning.

Classrooms are a state of the art facilities with full air-conditioner facilities. The library is a palace with a multitude of contents to explore. The quality of food is very good, and for non-vegetarian lovers, it is excellent. The campus is cashless, hence the transaction for an extra meal is digitalised.

faqs.answer: A:    IIM Kozhikode offers an Executive MBA course for a duration of two-years. As per the unofficial sources, the total fee for this course is INR 14 lakh. Fill an online application form on the official website of IIM Kozhikode with all the relevant details around the personal and educational details. Candidates must appear and qualify for the respective entrance exam before applying for the course and submit their entrance scores during the filling of the application form. Further, aspirants also upload a set of documents comprising their age proof, education certificates, photographs, signatures, etc. They also have to pay a non-refundable amount of application fee.
2.  Personal Interviews of Shortlisted Students

The Management Institute shortlists students based on their academic records, CAT qualifying, and CAT final cutoff for further selection rounds. The shortlisted students have to appear for a Personal Interview. A commutative score is then calculated based on candidates' performance in the selection rounds. Further, for the other courses, candidates who meet the eligibility criteria are required to go through the institute-specific selection process and get shortlisted.
3. Final Merit List

IIM Kozhikode publishes a category-wise merit list after the selection rounds. Students who make it to the merit list become eligible for admission. The selected candidates can further confirm their seats by paying the course admission fee.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIM Kozhikode for MBA?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking for admission to IIM Kozhikode must check the eligibility criteria for the course they want to apply at IIMK. Further, the second step is the application process. Candidates applying for Management courses must submit the scores of CAT/ GMAT/ GRE at the time of filling the application form. Further, the institute also conduct EMAT for admission to E-MBA course. Based on entrance exam scores, the shortlisted students are called for Written Ability Test (WAT)/ Personal Interview (PI). However, WAT/PI rounds are not conducted for all the courses. Later on, candidates are allocated seats as per their performance in the selection rounds.

faqs.question: How can I join MBA in IIM Kozhikode?
faqs.answer: For admission to a two-year MBA/ PGP course at IIM Kozhikode, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. Candidates who passed graduation with minimum 60% aggregate from a recognised university are eligible to apply for MBA course. However, there is a five percent relaxation for reserved category candidates and they must obtain a minimum of 55% aggregate in their final graduation. Securing a minimum qualifying cutoff means that the candidate will be eligible to apply for the WAT/GD-PI round. Also, IIM Kozhikode's final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff. paragraphs: DMS IIT Delhi admissions are open. Department of Management Studies popularly known as DMS IIT Delhi offers degrees at PG and PhD level in the field ofManagement. The flagship course ofDMS IIT Delhiis a 2-yearMBAcourse. The institute also offers anExecutive MBAcourse as a part-time, three-year programme for working professionals. Students can also pursue a short-term Management Development Programme at the institute. Admission to the full-time management course at DMS IIT Delhi is based on CAT scores while the Executive MBA admissions are based on a personal interview. For PhD, candidates should have a valid GATE/ UGC NET score along with fulfilling the respective eligibility criteria.

IIT Delhi MBA admission 2025is entrance-based. The institute offers MBA, MBA Telecom, Executive MBA, and PhD courses. The institute shortlists students on the basis of valid scores secured by them in the relevant entrance exam. Interested students can check out the following table to learn more about the eligibility and selection criteria for the popularDMS IIT Delhi courses:
Graduation with a minimum aggregate of 60% or 6.0 CGPA in any branch of PCM subjects (55% aggregate or 5 CGPA for SC/ST/PwD category)

DMS IIT Delhi admission 2025consists of various steps as a filteration process. Here is a detailed breakdown of theDMS IIT Delhi admission process:

Post application submission, candidates must appear for a screening process where the eligibility and selection criteria will be assessed. Applicants will then have to qualify for the respective entrance exam. Applicants must appear for the written test, where their verbal, analytical, quantitative/data interpretation and business awareness abilities will be tested.
After the screening round, applicants would be required to appear for a group discussion and personal interview. The interview is conducted through the video conferencing mode or in person.

After clearing all the rounds, the institution will notify the selected candidates of their admission status through email or other means. hostel_campus.college_name: DMS IIT Delhi Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: IIT, Delhi has a total number of 14 hostel; 11 for boys and 3 for girls. The boys’ hostels are Nilgiri, Karakoram, Aravali, Jwalamukhi,Satpura, Zanskar, Kumaon, Vindyachal, Shivalik, Girnar and Udaigir. Kailiash and Himadri Hostels are for girls. Each hostel in the institute is self-contained with amenities such as a reading room, an indoor games room, a lounge and a dining hall with mess.All rooms have been provided with Internet facilities.Xeroxing facilities and STD/ISD/PCO facilities are available in all the Hostels.

library.description: The IIT Delhi Library System comprises of a Central Library and departmental libraries. The Library has subscribed to  journals and a rich collection of books, Bound Volumes of Journals, standards, microfilms, theses, video cassettes, CDs and online electronic journals.The Library provides photocopying facility within the premises of the Library through an external vendor on payment basis.Also facilitates internet service. The Departmental Library at the Vishwakarma Bhavan has an extensive collection of books, working papers, audiovisual resources, annual reports, and bound volumes of periodicals and literature related to the management sciences

reviews.review_heading: Master of Business Administration from DMS IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: DMS at IIT Delhi has excellent infrastructure for the MBA course. Our department has all necessary facilities such as a library, canteen, Wi-Fi, and other amenities. Sports facilities are also available for students, and the campus is quite spacious. Hostel facilities are provided to students as well.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in my college were so super. Infrastructure of college was beautiful. Wi-Fi, classrooms, lab, and all things were available for the students. Library was not present in my college. The facility in my hostel canteen was so super. The food was very healthy and tasty. Medical facilities were also available. Sports and games were present in my college.

reviews.review_heading: Yes, you can take admission here.
reviews.review_text: The course is going to be tough; you have to be better in your studies. The course department is not as supportive as in a Ph.D.; you need to do a lot of research that requires a lot of time and effort but for this course, you do not have more resources, but you will have been given a high amount of pressure to publish a research paper.

reviews.review_heading: Reviews of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Campus hostels had state-of-the-art facilities including labs and auditoriums and provided top facilities like Wi-Fi and library access. Food was above average in the mess and canteen and there were multiple food courts on campus. Campus had a 24X7 running hospital for medical emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The college has the best infrastructure compared to the other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Our classrooms are very clean. The library has good books. We have clean washrooms. The hostel does not have good things. The food is the worst. Sports are good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements in our college aren't affected by Covid.
reviews.review_text: The campus life of the institute is students driven. It serves as a unique context of interaction among the students of different disciplines. SAC is the center of all the students' activities. The campus is equipped with a gymnasium, swimming pool, music room, etc. There are multiple hostels for boys and girls. We have a double sharing room in the 1st year and a single room in the 2nd year. Only vegetarian meals are served. The registration process is simple and the rent is affordable. The host...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, and different things are generally great however one thing that annoys a lot is that they don't pay attention to your ideas or grievances commonly. Lodgings are all around great and perfect and different offices like wreck are additionally great, the culinary specialist prepares great food and is likewise well disposed of. There is a clinic where you get free examine as an understudy. Sports offices are simply great, practically every one of the games is there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DMS IIT Delhi - Department of Management Studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. IIT hostels are built with students convenience. Quality of food, as well as variety, is great. In a typical week, we usually get all kinds of cuisines so that we don't get bored with the same food, and students get dishes from their native places.

reviews.review_heading: DMS, IIT Delhi is the best in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: Mostly IIT Delhi hostels are very old but are maintained well. There might be a feeling as it lacks space, but it is a delight to have a hostel life with your friends here. The food served in the mess isn't that bad, and there are separate mess committees in every hostel to take care of them.

reviews.review_heading: Really good faculty and infrastructure facilities.
reviews.review_text: DMS has all the facilities required for the students as being the finest institute if the research field is concerned. Institute has 24 hrs Wi-Fi facility, very well-equipped labs with all the facilities required and library with a lot of books. IIT Delhi being the well-known brand is very well-equipped with all the facilities regarding sports and games.

2. Except for the size of rooms of the hostels every thing is good. Size of room is a little bit small.

Beautiful campus with lots of greenery infrastructure was quite good air-conditioned labs, lecture halls, sports and recreation facilities, hostels as we used to share the campus with IIT students and it was a wonderful experience. Food of hostel is very good and Wi-Fi speed is ver...

reviews.review_heading: Good College with competent faculty members and students with a 100% placement record.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities provided by the college for our course are really good, and so much of support for the students from the faculty members side in enabling learning process. Hostel facilities and food are hygienic and good. Students are also given medical facility, and also sports and games facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Superb and amazing time with good placements.

paragraphs: IIM Lucknow admissionsare based on CAT scores for its flagship PGP programmes. The institute also considers scores in GMAT, XAT, GATE, etc. for admission to other courses.IIM Lucknowis one of the top IIMs with competitive admission process. The institute is ranked at '5' under the 'Management' category in NIRF 2025 rankings. Besides PGP, the institute offers Executive PGP, FPM and certificate programmes. Interested candidates have to fill out the application form for the preferred course.

People who intend to enroll to an IIM Lucknow course must be sure that they have verified the requirements before applying. In addition, the final seat distribution is done depending on the criteria of selection. The course-wise eligibility and selection is stated as under table:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with a minimum 50% aggregate
CAT+ WAT + PI
Download Test paper:FREECAT Mock Test
Executives with a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 50% aggregate
Master’s degree or its equivalent with a minimum 55% aggregate

In the case of the IIM Lucknow PGP, only those aspirants who have a valid CAT score that corresponds to the cutoff of admission in IIML are considered.Therefore, in the case of this flagship course, applicants will be required to go through the CAT application procedure and attend the examination.In case of other programs like Executive PGP, FPM or Certificate, the applications may be made directly through the official site of IIM Lucknow.In the case of the Executive PGP course, the accepted tests are GMAT/ CAT / XAT/ GATE/ PGP-WE Entrance Exam and in the case of FPM, the test would be CAT/ GATE/ GRE/ GMAT or JRF/ SRF (UGC/ CSIR/ ICAR).
STEP 1: IIM Lucknow Application Process 2025

The application process of Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is done online. For DPM course admission, after the online registration, candidates shall send a copy of the filled form along with all the documents through the post to the institute. For PGP, complete the CAT application process and for other courses, visit the institute's official website.
STEP 2: Written Ability Test (WAT)/Personal Interview Round

The applicants are shortlisted based on merit in the CAT entrance test and academic merit has to take the WAT/PI round. Further, a commutative score is calculated for final selections. For the other programmes, students who fulfil the minimum eligibility are shortlisted based on course-specific selection criteria.
STEP 3: Release of Merit List
Once all the selection rounds are completed, the selection list in terms of categories may be published on the official site.The candidates that get to the rank list become eligible to be admitted.
STEP 4: Confirmation
The selected candidates can confirm their seats by paying the required course admission fee.

placement_data.title: IIM Lucknow Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IIM Lucknow has concluded the placements for the Class of 2025. The students of the PGP and PGP - ABM batch 2025 secured 604 job offers in the academic year 2024-25. The highest and average package offered to the PGP and PGP - ABM students was INR 75 LPA and INR 32.3 LPA . The students secured offers from prominent recruiters of several domains like Consulting, Product, Tech, Sales & marketing, General Management, etc. C onsulting was the top recruiting domain with placement distribution of 38%. Accenture was the one of the top recruiters with 54 offers. Some of the top recruiters of IIM Lucknow in 2025 include Adobe, Deloitte, PwC, BCG, Ey, American Express, bain & Companiy, etc.

The highest and average package received by the 9th batch of PGP SM (2023-25) was INR 45.37 LPA and INR 22.66 LPA . The students secured 65% Sustainabilty roles and 35% General management Roles in the IIM Lucknow placement cycle 2025. IT sector emerged as the top recruiting sector with placement distribution of 32%.

IIM Lucknow has also published the 2025 placement report for the International Program in Management for Executives (IPMX). The average package for IPMX students in 2025 was INR 27.72 LPA while the median package was INR 27.19 LPA . 29 companies made placement offers and 38% of them were new recruiters.

reviews.review_heading: Overall Satisfied with the experience at IIM Lucknow.
reviews.review_text: Hostel accommodation is mandatory as it is a residential program. The quality of hostel rooms is also good. Everyone is allocated a single, separate room. There are no restrictions or curfew timings as such on campus. Wi-Fi is available on campus, and meals served at the mess are okay, better than in other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Do MBA on your own risk .
reviews.review_text:
Indoor sports, washing machines but old, football ground, cricket ground, library which is really good, swimming pool, gym, state, computer centre, green nature trails
Hostels are decent, clean but very old washrooms, total 18 hostels, except 17,18 hostel others are very old but clean enough for use.

reviews.review_heading: A brief review of IIM LUCKNOW .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is good whole campus has the availability of high-speed Internet, labs are well-equipped with all necessary equipment, classrooms are big and comfortable, there is a big library where all self study material is available. Hostel has big room with separate B.Ed for each student. Mess quality is acceptable, canteen is costly, medical and sport facilities are available in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Lucknow - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is excellent. Our campus has the availability of high-speed Wi-Fi. Labs are well-maintained. Classrooms are comfortable. There is a library where you will find self-study materials. The hostel has big rooms. They provide a bed to every student. Sports facilities are good. The food served in the mess is average. The food served in the canteen is expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good facilities and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: There were 3 types of hostels. They were old dorms, new dorms, and married student hostels. Two mess halls served food to the whole IIMA community. In terms of quality, I would rate it as average, considering the type of food served. It was mandatory to stay in hostels for PGP students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Lucknow - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Our college had an excellent infrastructure. High-speed Wi-Fi was available on campus 24X7. Labs were equipped with all necessary equipments. Classrooms had good and comfortable furniture. A well-stocked library was available for students. The hostel had big rooms. Every student got a bed. There were good sports facilities and medical assistance. The quality of food in the mess was acceptable, but students preferred to eat outside. The food items in the canteen were costly for students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Lucknow - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. There is comfortable furniture in the college. Our campus is high-speed internet enabled. There is an excellent and well-stocked library with a silent atmosphere of self-study. The hostel is average. The hostel furniture is good. The food served in the hostel canteen is expensive. Medical facilities are good. Our college provides us with sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in Lucknow for MBA.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are pretty much good. There are single and double occupant rooms with AC and non AC facilities. We have Wi-Fi, a washing machine and a good canteen that is open even at night time. They provide mattresses, study tables, wooden almirah etc. Mess food is healthy. The institute also provides sports gym facilities to the students.

reviews.review_heading: 100% of placements are provided even in the pandemic year, 2020.
reviews.review_text: There are various facilities and amenities at IIM Lucknow, such as a post office, bank, departmental store, retail shops located within the vicinity of the college. There's a play area for squash, basketball, tennis, a gym, a swimming pool, and a Jacuzzi. There are in-house medical experts who take care of students in case of emergencies. The hostel can accommodate more than 1000 students, and there's room available for faculty members as well. The rooms are spacious and air-conditioned, with at...

reviews.review_heading: It is way more expensive than other colleges, but it is good.
reviews.review_text: An annual fest named MV is held in December. There are many clubs and committees covering music, dance, acting, and business on the campus which makes the campus life more fun. Sports like badminton, cricket, and football are the main facilities available. Hostel and mess facilities are provided on the campus itself. There are 17 hostels, including 5 girls' hostels, and everyone gets a separate room. The mess facility is awesome, the quality of food is really better than other hostels. The mess ...

reviews.review_heading: A place which will make you the finest version of yourself.
reviews.review_text:
1) All the facilities and infrastructure were available in college campus such as Air Conditioned classrooms, Exam halls, Library, Computer labs, Hostel Wi-Fi, separate rooms etc. 
2) The quality of facilities were really praiseworthy- exceptionally maintained and well cleaned buildings, uninterrupted power supply, super fast Wi-Fi and internet connection through LAN, the quality of food in mess was very good and very less spicy so no question of getting ill health. There were other canteens whe...

reviews.review_heading: One of the best Management institutions in India. Focus on holistic development.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure, probably India's best mess and uninterrupted connectivity. The campus is as open as it gets and there is a lot going on. Academics, sports, community work and multiple fests. The mess food is beyond expectations. The administration is open and supportive.

reviews.review_heading: PGP at IIM Lucknow - Decoding unleashed the best out of me.
reviews.review_text: In academic block and library, we had infrastructure of top notch quality. We had 24*7 access to the computer centre and library. During, the harsh summers of Lucknow. Both of the above places used to be a real saviour. In classrooms, we do have Wi-Fi connectivity and a nice seating arrangement. In the hostels, we do have separate rooms and the rooms are spacious enough. As we don't have ACs, summers can be really harsh and equally harsh could be the winters as well.

reviews.review_heading: Agribusiness Management at IIM Lucknow: Decoded. Good placement and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Internet access is good throughout the campus. All hostels are internet enabled (Wi-Fi or LAN). Wi-Fi is accessible even from the PGP Academic Blocks (Bodhigrih-I and Bodhigrih-II) and the Library. The Computer Labs are open 24x7. They have a spacious cubicle-like seating arrangement with comfortable seating. They are air-conditioned and there is round-the-clock access to black and white and colour printers. The Library is also open 24x7 and houses a repository of rich resources and access to ma...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Lucknow - Indian Institute of Management (IIML).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIM Lucknow was pretty good. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and the rooms have LAN ports. Classrooms are fully functional with cooling facilities, projectors and other equipment. A medical centre, canteens and other facilities were available on the campus. Hostels were spacious. Ample space was available for both indoor and outdoor sports.

data.description: With many years of industry experience, IIM Lucknow faculty acts as facilitators of high-quality education in the students’ learning process. IIML faculty include assistant professors, professors, guests, and visiting faculty members. Most of the professors teaching at IIM Lucknow are PhD degree holders.

paragraphs: The SIBM Pune application process for both programmes is conducted in online mode. Candidates applying for a full-time MBA and MBA (IE) have to register for SNAP. SIBM Pune admission is a multi-step process. Candidates can refer to the following steps to understand each stage of the admission process:
1. The applications are accepted via online mode. You can apply atwww.sibm.edu. Aspirants need to pay an application fee ofINR 1,000for SNAP and submit it before the last date.
2. SIBM Pune MBA course admission is done based on the candidate's score on the SNAP test.

3. Candidates are shortlisted based on scores in the entrance exam. Candidates who have applied for an MBA have to participate in group exercises and interview round. For the EMBA course, candidates are shortlisted based on merit and directly called for a personal interview.

4. The institute releases the merit list on the official website of the institute. Following the seat matrix, the seats are allotted to candidates based on merit in the entrance exam and personal interview. Selected candidates can pay theSIBM Pune feeto further confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good enough to study according to Indian standards.
reviews.review_text: There are three hostels which are located in new, old and annex within close range to mess with double, triple and single sharing rooms separately for boys and girls. The food is also good enough with proper quality check and clealiness. There are sports and entertainment facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College campus is large enough.
reviews.review_text: The college does not have its boys hostel it has three girls hostels of its own they have tie ups with private hostels there are hostel which offer you a room at 90,000 to hostels where the price is 2,75,000 the food is good in my hostel I would recommend a first year student to stay in a hostel for a year then shift to a flat.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: One of the best campuses in the country. Hostel rooms are clean and airy and are available on twin or 3-sharing. The hostel has a basketball court,  2 badminton courts, a squash court, a swimming pool, a football stadium, a gym, and an aerobics centre. There are PGs around within the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 per month. However, by the second year, most students prefer staying in flats with their friends, and they are all available close to the college. The course is divided into trimeste...

The campus has a hostel to support the residential programme.

reviews.review_heading: Great college and campus.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune is the hilltop heaven. The campus is really a heaven, surrounded with greenery, it feels like a scenic beauty. Many Bollywood movies are shot in SIBM Pune. The hostels are wonderful as well. There is double/triple/quadruple sharing rooms, with attached washrooms.

reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune is situated at lavale hills, and it is referred as Hill-top heaven. The institute has great infrastructure in terms of Academics, Hostels, sports and extra curricular activities. Special mention would be behavioral lab, bloomberg terminal,  2 huge Auditoriums and fully wi-fi campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review about Symbiosis institute of business management, Pune.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune is defined as hilltop heaven. The major reason is because of its excellent campus located at the hills of lavale with an excellent cafeteria called symbieats and world-class library facilities provided for the students. We have 2 girls and 2 boys hostels and apart from that we have mess, cafeteria and laundry services in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college has great placements and amazing campus life.
reviews.review_text: Rooms in the hostel are spacious, and LAN helps us with great internet speed. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Classrooms are good, and the library has all varieties of books. Bloomberg terminal and information technology lab is also available here to help us.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and infrastructure are good, but the salary package offered is average.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms and library facilities are good, but there is an issue with Wi-Fi at some places on the campus. college_info.intro:
XLRI Jamshedpur flagship programme is PGDM. The college offers PGDM programmes both in a full-time, residential format and through its online learning platform. XLRI offers an 18-month full-time residential management programme, PGDM (GM), previously known as GMP. The PGDM GM programme is accredited by AICTE, AMBA and other prestigious bodies. The curriculum of this course is integrated with theoretical as well as practical subjects.
XLRI also offers PGDM programmes in other specialisations including HRM, Business Management and Finance. The XLRI Online PGDM programme is delivered online with three one-week campus immersion modules during term I at the start, term III and term V. overview_faqs.question: What is the XAT application fee?
overview_faqs.answer: The XAT application fee is INR 2,200. The XAT fee is to be paid online at the time of forms submission. The fee is same for candidates belonging to all categories. Unlike other MBA entrance exams, there is no rebate for Reserved category candidates in XAT. If you select XLRI in the application form for admission, you will have to pay INR 200 additionally.The fee can be paid via debit/credit card, cash card, mobile wallets, or net-banking. It is mandatory to pay the application fee before deadline for successful registration. Candidates can fill the application form and pay the fee later, however they will need to make the fee payment before the registration deadline so that their form is accepted by the examination authority. individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Human Resource Management - Batch of 2022

content.Placements: Placements in our college are amongst the best in the nation. Top recruiting companies are Brain, McKinsey, Accenture, Strategy, and FMCGs like P&G, HUL, and Mondelez. paragraphs: ForXLRI admission, candidates are required to apply online. Candidates can apply for more than one programme at the same time.XLRI admission processincludes an application process, shortlisting of candidates for GD & PI, the release of cutoff and announcement of the final list for admission. Find more details on each of the stages of the admission process:
1:XLRI Application Process 2026

The admission process begins with the filling of the application form. Eligible candidates can visit the XLRI official website (xlri.ac.in) to apply. For PGDM, aspirants have to register for XAT. The application fee for XAT isINR 2,200andINR 200each for every additional programme of XLRI.
2:Selection

Candidates must appear for the XAT entrance test to be eligible forXLRI PGDM admission 2026. Soon after the declaration of the XAT result, XLRI releases the admission cutoff list. Those who meet theXAT cutoff, are eligible to appear for the Personal Interview (PI) round ofXLRI course admission. Candidates with a valid GMAT or GRE score can also apply for PGDM GM. The institute selects candidates for Executive programmes based on their XAT or GMAT scores.
Candidates must have a valid national-level entrance exam score such as XAT, GMAT, GRE, GATE, UGC-JRF or NET for admission to FPM programme.
3:Final Admission

The college shortlists students for PI based on their entrance exam scores. Apart from national-level entrance exam scores and screening of applications, XLRI also considers work experience, educational background and extracurricular activities.
4:Admission Confirmation

The final merit list and admission confirmation is based on XAT scores, Group Discussion and Personal Interview, etc. The institute releases the merit list of selected students for the final admission.

reviews.review_heading: Xlri one of the best college in india.
reviews.review_text: XlRI has an excellent infrastructure. All the facilities in the college campus are top notch. There are all facilities like labs, big classrooms, library. College campus has Wi-Fi supply too. There are all the sports facilities too in the college. The hostel of the college is also top notch. The food in the hostel mess and canteen is healthy and delicious. Overall it is a good college campus and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides the best placement offers.
reviews.review_text: Our college library is one of the most extensively stocked libraries and has almost every book an MBA student might need. There is a multitude of premium subscriptions for students like HBR, Economic Times, etc. Each classroom is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi and charging points. There are multiple study rooms available for students. XLRI also has a fully equipped gymnasium, football field, and volleyball court. Each student gets a single room with a wardrobe, a bed, a table, and a chair. There...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides awesome placements and friendly faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Campus has an amazing environment which is well facilitated with the necessary facilities. There is a recreational room, sports ground, auditorium, seminar halls, computer labs, finance labs, medical emergency facilities, video conferencing facilities, etc. Hostel facilities offered were very satisfactory. Single rooms were provided to every student which was facilitated with the best facilities. Food served in the mess was top-class in quality. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food varieties ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of XLRI Xavier School of Management.
reviews.review_text: Sports infrastructure was good in this college. The campus was always alive. The library was extensive and comfortable and there was rarely any book students will not find here. Classrooms were equipped with the latest infrastructure. The hostels were clean, all students had their room but shared washrooms. The meal quality was medium and overall all the amenities were good enough. The premises were cleaned regularly and students can voice concerns if needed. Apart from some negligible issues, t...

reviews.review_heading: Our college is worth all the hard-earned money.
reviews.review_text: Sports activities are given a lot of importance at XLRI. There are separate fields and areas for badminton, basketball, cricket, football, tennis, and volleyball. A sports festival named Ensemble Valhalla is also organised here. XLRI has a perfect environment for learning. Sir Jahangir Library has over 69,500 books, 49 electronic resources and databases, 90 print magazines and journals, etc. There are 22 classrooms with a seating capacity of 70, and each classroom has been designed like an amphi...

reviews.review_heading: There were excellent placements in our batch.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is modern and has decent classrooms and mess facilities. The food served in the mess and canteen is affordable, and its price is fair. There are 3 computer laboratories and research classrooms. The library has a good collection of books, journals and magazines and has a decent studying area also. The campus is beautiful and near to a natural environment. There is an arrangement for sports activities also, but we got very less time due to constant studies and internship...

reviews.review_heading: There is no better college than this.
reviews.review_text: Every sporting facility, top-class library, lush green environment, amazing weather and internet connectivity are very seamless. The academic rigor and extra activities are always conducted here.

reviews.review_heading: It is a professional course with ample learning and improvement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: My classmates are staying in the hostels, and I get to know information from them regarding various facilities provided to them. The campus has a high functioning Wi-Fi facility and a library with many latest journals from scientific and management publishing authorities. Sports facilities provided here include a tennis court and basketball court for all the students.

reviews.review_heading: Great culture which ensures senior-junior interaction and peer learning, amazing placements.
reviews.review_text: Every facility is available, library is huge along with an option of remote access of resources. Learning centers are air-conditioned with all the necessary facilities. Wi-Fi is available almost everywhere in the campus. Hostels have single sharing rooms with all the necessary facilities. Ample number of washing machines and water coolers are available on every floor. Laundry and dry cleaning services are also available in campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of XLRI Xavier School of Management.
reviews.review_text: XLRI has a superb campus in Jamshedpur with all the facilities, which students would require in a top college. Unlike engineering college, B-School hostels are much better in terms of facilities and also in food quality. XLRI is a private college, so all the facilities in the hostel and mess were good.

reviews.review_heading: XLRI Jamshedpur is amongst the top 10 B Schools of India.
reviews.review_text: XLRI Jamshedpur Campus is best in its class. It was really very great pleasure and proud to spend 2 golden years of our life at this campus. Campus is very well developed with various facilities. Our hostel facility was also good, I always felt that I was at my home only.

reviews.review_heading: Brilliant must have experience.
reviews.review_text: It has top-notch in terms of available facilities and infrastructure. The quality of life at XLRI is brilliant art both academics and extra curriculums, the standard of food and amenities available is above par and is in line with the few they ask. The campus is very beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: Review of XLRI Xavier School of Management.
reviews.review_text: Labs were all equipped with Wi-Fi which was pretty decent. Since it is an old college, so classroom infrastructure was a bit outdated, but still, they have now built a separate building to accomodate the increasing students. Library and classrooms are above average. Food served is awesome, and the rest things are above average.

reviews.review_heading: It is a perfect college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is excellent. There are single rooms in the hostel. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi. Moreover, LAN nodes are also provided in all the hostel as well as classrooms. The library is equipped with 1.5 lacs books and has functional seating capacity.

reviews.review_heading: Premier business school, provides everything that you expect!
reviews.review_text: The hostels are clean and hygienic, with single room occupancy. The entire campus has a Wi-Fi access. The classrooms and library are air conditioned and adequate in size. The mess food is very good as compared to the general perception of food available on hostels. There is a 24/7 infirmary and doctor availability. There are facilities for most popular sports like Football, Badminton, Cricket, Snooker, Table tennis etc.

Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Andhra University climbed 2 ranks to #23 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown an increasing trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Andhra University climbed 2 ranks to #88 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

faqs.question: How do I get admission to SP Jain (SPJIMR)?
faqs.answer: SP Jain Institute of Management and Research admission is primarily entrance-based. Candidates are first required to register for the programme of their choice. Once the registration is done, the institute shortlists candidates for admission. SP Jain shortlists candidates for PGDM/ PGPM programmes based onCAT/ GMATscores followed by a personal interview round. Besides, the final selection is based on academic background, versatility and achievements, entrance exam and PI. For FPM, admission is based on the Research Aptitude Test followed by PI. The selection for GMP programme is based on CAT, XAT, GMAT, etc. followed by PI.

faqs.question: Does SPJIMR also select students based solely on their profiles without even taking any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: SPJIMR shortlists candidates for its flagship programme i.e. PGDM based on their profiles. The profiles are evaluated, and the applicants are sorted into two groups: Profile-based and Profile-cum-Score-based. In the first phase, candidates shortlisted based on their profile are called for a Personal Interview (PI). However, the second phase is held after the availability of entrance test scores. That means, the institute accepts entrance exam scores as well for admission. The accepted entrance exam for PGDM is CAT/ GMAT. For admission to FPM, aspirants need to appear for Research Aptitude Test followed by a personal interview round. The institute shortlists candidates for admission to GMP based on scores of the candidates in CAT, GMAT, GRE, etc.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for PGDM at SPJIMR?
faqs.answer: SP Jain Institute of Management and Research offers admission to the PGDM course on the basis of merit obtained in the qualifying exam as well as the scores obtained in the national-level entrance exam (CAT/ XAT/ MAT/ NMAT/ CMAT/ ATMA/ GMAT). In order to secure admission to the PGDM programme at SPJIMR, candidates must obtain a minimum of 50% in graduation along with valid entrance scores.

reviews.review_heading: Stepping zone of my career.
reviews.review_text: The mode of fee payments would be arranged according to the facilities provided by the students. All modes of money transactions should be accepted by the college. Supports students with both the mode of studying and helps us in the usage of online tools.

reviews.review_heading: A few notes about my college.
reviews.review_text: Sometimes it's difficult to understand the college's working process. The cultural and other events are conducted at the request of students. But in the previous year, they didn't conduct any events. At the entrance of the college, we must sign the records for entry while we choose to use the campus bus for transportation.

reviews.review_heading: Well-furnished course in a reputed college.
reviews.review_text: This college would be economically preferable for students from various backgrounds. All the online and offline resources and technologies would be accessible to all the students. Individual enrollment identity cars would be given to all the students for easier accessibility. Also, encourage us to collect scholarships for doing our courses.

reviews.review_heading: A short description of my college.
reviews.review_text: The management of the college always says that participation is more important than winning or losing. Students dress conservatively according to their convenience, but it must be formal. They pave a path for creation, innovation, and implementation, followed by success.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PGDM in Business Management
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very constructive and well architecturally developed. CCTV cameras and security cameras are fixed in each department to monitor students, and this is managed by the higher authorities of the college. Also, speakers are fixed in every classroom to communicate emergency information.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are clean and big. The technologies are modified and updated. Wi-Fi is available. A well-stocked library is present. The hostel facilities are very good. The quality of the food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Global management program at SPJIMR.
reviews.review_text: The campus is an enlarged greenery, covering nearly 45 acres, with buses and a serene lake. The campus is also built with halls, auditoriums, recreational rooms, and laboratories. Especially, hostel areas are built with cafes and lounges, particularly for boys and girls students.

reviews.review_heading: SPJIMR, Mumbai is a prestigious organization.
reviews.review_text: Students from different backgrounds and regions are encouraged to pursue their preferred courses without any experience of splitting or groups. There are no chances of harassment, discrimination, or ragging within the campus. The college is under the surveillance of college authorities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned with the required technology. The seating is fully furnished with lockers for keeping records and notebooks. Classrooms are neatly represented by students using chart works related to subjects. Foods are commonly cooked for all the students in afternoon which includes hosteller's too.

reviews.review_heading: A journey of growth, enjoyment, personal and professional development.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and mess facilities at SP Jain Institute of Management and Research (SPJIMR) are the best. The hostel washrooms are cleaned every day, and the mess facilities are clean and hygienic. The staff are professional and conscientious. The classroom facilities are also state-of-the art, with amenities suited for offline and online modes of teaching.

reviews.review_heading: College review for SP College.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is good, making it amazing for people. It has good labs and Wi-Fi quality. It has a good canteen serving delicious food, also available in Jain options. It has a lake beside it, making it a fun experience overall. Thus, I enjoy the college.

placement_report.college_name: IIFT Delhi Placements 2025: Average Package, Highest Package, Top Recruiters

placement_data.title: IIFT Delhi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: 7 international offers were made to MBA IB students during the IIFT Delhi MBA IB placement drive 2025. The overall highest package recorded was INR 123 LPA . The median package for MBA IB and MBA BA courses this year was INR 26 LPA and 20 LPA . Consulting was the top recruiting domain for MBA IB and IT & Analytics was the domain for MBA BA with placement distribution of 22% and 28%.
The overall highest and average package received during IIFT Delhi placement 2025 for MA Economics program was INR 24 LPA and INR 12 LPA.

Earlier, the overall highest and average stipend offered (for two months) during IIFT Delhi summer placement 2025 for the MBA IB batch of 2024-26 stood at INR 6 lakh and INR 2.73 lakh. Sales and Marketing domain emerged as the top recruiting domain. For the MBA BA batch of 2024-26, the highest and average stipend stood at INR 4 lakh and INR 1.42 lakh.

The highest domestic and international package offered during IIFT Delhi placements 2024 stood at INR 75.6 LPA and INR 85.4 LPA , respectively. The average and median package received by the MBA IB batch 2022-24 was INR 27.3 LPA and INR 25 LPA . More than 120 recruiters visited the campus and 10 international positions were offered during IIFT MBA placements 2024. Sales and Marketing emerged as the top recruiting domain with placement distribution of 22%.

The MBA IB batch of 2022-24 (including Delhi and Kolkata campus) constituted 68.8% male candidates and 33.2 female candidates. 15.2% of the entire batch was from premier Institutes such as IITs and NITs whereas 47.5% of the batch was from DU and other Central Universities . In reference to the educational background the students, 52.1% of the batch was from Engineering background while the remaining 21.8%, 16.6% and 9.5% of the batch came from Commerce / Business, Science / Pharma and Arts & Other backgrounds, respectively. The average work experience of IIFT MBA 2022-24 batch was 19.20 months.

library.description:
The library has a collection over 84,000 volumes and subscriptions to 800 journals with complete online cataloging. IIFT Library is a veritable storehouse of information. The library has a unique collection of publications of FAO, IMF, OECD, UNCTAD, UNCTC, World Bank, and other international agencies. IIFT has set up the WTO Resource Centre in the Library to focus exclusively on WTO issues. 
Presently Foreign Trade Library has a collection of 1,03,407 resources that comprises76,422 book/CDs-volumes, 17581 bound periodicals, and 255 periodicals / Journals. The library has also installed 12 Bloomberg terminals in the Library. The specific features of Bloomberg Database are that it provides a range of Global Economic data and live changes for stocks Markets, Company Reports, Sector analysis, and future trends.

reviews.review_heading: Review of M.A. Economics in the specialisation of trade and finance at this college.
reviews.review_text: It has the most enthusiastic and energetic environment, which induces the positive mindset of the students. Student unions are strongly supported by the college management, and they help them while they are involved in some socially responsible activities. Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is known for its excellence in academic coaching.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for M.A. in Economics Course.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has excellent infrastructure. The college has a dynamic campus. Students and faculty have access to Wi-Fi on the college campus. Students have access to labs and libraries that are fully equipped. The college classrooms were well-equipped with appropriate facilities and excellent teaching tools. There was also a restaurant at the college.

reviews.review_heading: College has good faculty for our course.
reviews.review_text: IIFT Delhi has really good infrastructure for the students. The quality of the facilities available at our college is of good quality. College Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, and sports facilities are available on the campus. Students receive proper support from the college management.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Foreign Trade, Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a peaceful and stress-free environment. They provide huge support and show interest in sports.

reviews.review_heading: College has really good infrastructure and faculty for our course.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has a very good infrastructure. College has a lively campus. The campus of the college has Wi-Fi for the students and teachers. Labs and libraries are available for the students with all the necessary stuff. Classrooms of the college were having proper furniture and projectors for better explanation. A canteen facility was also available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The quality of the offered facilities and faculty was good enough at IIFT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the IIFT was good for the MBA programme. All the necessary facilities were offered in the MBA programme. Wi-Fi was available on the entire campus. The labs and library of the college were good. Hostel facilities were also available for the students. Mess and canteen food were good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I am satisfied with all the facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides Wi-Fi facility and classrooms, and computer labs are equipped with the latest technology. Everything is available here, but the campus is small.  Hostels are not very good and don't have air-conditioners. Even hostels are of triple sharing basis, and there is a small and old building for hostels. The mess is also small. However, medical facilities are good, and sports and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied from faculty members but the placements are very good .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good. The classrooms lack many facilities as compared to other colleges. The library is good. The hostels are below average and not so good infrastructure and condition. The quality and taste of food is not so good. The facility for sports and games are good .

reviews.review_heading: Placements have been on par compared with its peers, but there is a scope for improvement.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and library are fully equipped with the Wi-Fi facility, which can be provided to your laptops. The mess menu changes according to the feedback of the students and the mess contractor. There are two hostels, and one is an old hostel for juniors, while the other one is a new hostel for seniors.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides great opportunities and exposure to the industry.
reviews.review_text: The campus at Qutab Institutional Area is compact and good enough to fulfil the requirements of an MBA programme. The campus is among many other prominent institutes located in the region. The location of the campus and the overall atmosphere makes it conducive to learning. The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi connectivity, 2 hostels each with its own mess, auditorium, conference halls and classrooms. A new campus for IIFT is coming to UPAT Maidan Garhi, New Delhi.

reviews.review_heading: IIFT is the best college for IB.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has a decent infrastructure. There are digital classrooms, auditorium, a huge library with all resources and databases, spacious hostel rooms, and mess food is also decent. The only thing our college lacks is the outdoor sports facilities. However, gym and indoor sports facilities are available. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my experience in the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average. IIFT doesn't have any sports grounds. Wi-Fi facilities are extremely poor. Classroom and hostel facilities are decent. Quality of food in the mess is extremely pathetic (probably the only thing which I don't like about IIFT)

reviews.review_heading: A holistic learning experience for prospective leaders. It is in one among the top B-Schools.
reviews.review_text: With a campus spanning a tad over 6 acres, the institute is equipped with digitally powered classrooms, an auditorium with a capacity of 500 people, an MDP centre and a library. It is thereby, creating an environment conducive to learning. The infrastructure is lacking in terms of avenues and facilities for a sports enthusiast. The hostels are well maintained. Quality of food in the mess is always a matter of debate in B-Schools across the country.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with my decision to join IIFT because of great faculty and amazing placements.
reviews.review_text: The library of this college is the largest in this developing world, with a holding of around 84,000 volumes and subscriptions to 800 journals with complete online cataloguing. We have access to Bloomberg terminals, and the whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The college has state-of-the-art infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The placements and the campus experience along with the crowd makes IIFT the place to be.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure could be categorised at average currently but a new campus nearing completion in 2020 would address most of the issues for the Delhi campus with the Kolkata campus recently shifting to a newer one. The food is average along with the Hostels.

hostel.description: Alagappa University has 15 hostels with 427 rooms for men and women research scholars and graduate students of the University. Separate hostel for the overseas students. The hostel rooms are well furnished and well ventilated. There is provision to accommodate around 1,200 students. The hostels have separate hygienic mess halls, reading rooms supplemented with leading English and Tamil dailies, magazines and Employment News.

library.description: The Central Library of Alagappa University includes one lakh volumes of printed books, subscriptions to 149 printed periodicals, 492 items of non-book materials, and 1446 volumes of theses in print form. Access to 6242+ numbers of Online journals and 1,31,000+ numbers of e-theses are also available. The Library has all the amenities of a University Library – an inviting exterior, spacious Reading Halls, three-tier Stack Rooms, lucrative Conference Hall, elegant Discussion Room; Rooms for the Librarian, Library staff and different sections of the Library. Besides the Central Library, there are four aculty Libraries and Department Libraries to cater to the needs of the users in the respective locations. The Central Library is kept open on all the days of the year, except on Public Holidays (approximately 340 days in a year). The working hours are, on weekdays from 8-00A.M to 8.00 P.M., and during weekends from 10-00 A.M. to 5-00 P.M.
