reviews.review_heading: Recommended for students who are able to pay moderate fee.
reviews.review_text: This is one of the top universities in Karaikudi which has highlighted features and performances that are quickly noticeable from their college website. Hostellers are levied with reasonable charges for accommodation as well as food expenses. Tuition fees vary from one person to another based on their previous records and their history.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best university for the M.A. in History course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and equipment in our office were beautiful. There was always Wi-Fi. Labs and classrooms were well-maintained. Besides the central library, there was a departmental library. At the hotel, the mess food was tolerable. The university hospital was good and close by. There was an ambulance that would come and pick you up if you got sick.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university for M.A. in economics course.
reviews.review_text: Our college offered 100 Mbps Wi-Fi. Labs were fully functional with all equipment. Our college had a central library on the 4th floor with more than 2,000 books. Hostel food had good value for money. The restaurant was open until midnight. Medical facilities were available 24X7, including an ambulance service. Our college had great sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best university for MBA course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was solid. The wireless network was impressive. Nevertheless, Wi-Fi was accessible only for laptops. University bans the use of mobile phones for Wi-Fi. The infrastructure was solid. Additionally, the laboratories were available during extended hours for interested students. Classrooms and libraries were beneficial. The hostel accommodations were fairly simple, lacking in any luxuries.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best College for an MBA in Logistics and Supply Chain Management course.
reviews.review_text: The college building has 8 floors, and it is the tallest building in Tamil Nadu. The college has a Wi-Fi facility in the computer lab, and the classrooms have blackboards with display devices. A library of non-new books. The college offers separate hostels for boys and girls.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Nachiappa Swamigal Arts and Science CollegeReviewed on 8 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good for the fee charged, but placements are poor. The faculty is good.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, but the hostel is average. It's a small college, and the fee structure is affordable. We are more likely to join the college. It's totally disappointing. So I suggest students do not expect the college and college life. Students can go to the college directly, visit classrooms, and decide to join the college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chennais Amirta International Institute of Hotel ManagementReviewed on 2 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: They have the best facilities, and the infrastructure is good. They teach every single thing very well. Honestly, I don't know much about the hostel because I travel from home, but my friends who stay in the hostel say it has good quality. They get food three times a day, and sports and games are conducted.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2018Offered by Thiagarajar School of ManagementReviewed on 26 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for placements.
reviews.review_text: All facilities available in the hostel were good, and the food served in the mess had good taste. Sports and games were also available. There was good infrastructure and a big ground. In our college, the hostel was very close to the college. Wi-Fi is there in every class. Our campus provides facilities like computer labs, Dell systems, iOS lab, library, canteen, playground, etc.

reviews.review_heading: This is the greatest college overall.
reviews.review_text: The best materials were used for the classrooms, restrooms, library, canteen, hostel, and other facilities at this college, which had excellent infrastructure. Every facility was open. In addition to having clean food, the canteen has nice facilities. However, during the yearlong vacation, athletic events were only planned once a year.

reviews.review_heading: If you only want to study it's heaven.
reviews.review_text: The department of facilities was good because most of the necessary facilities were provided like water filters, air-conditioners, fans, Wi-Fi, etc. Hostel facilities were also same like AC, water, Wi-Fi, etc. Food quality was also good and hygiene was maintained.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Caussanel College of Arts and ScienceReviewed on 15 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good placement and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: My classroom has fast Wi-Fi and NEET halls with AC. The hostel has rooms with attached bathrooms and also common bathrooms. Every night, our hostel has a doctor's visit with medicines. The mess has 100 fans. Sports are taught without any extra fees, and we study in the same college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best university for M.Sc. in chemistry course.

faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.

paragraphs: IIM Raipur offers Certification, PG, and doctoral-level courses in the field of management. Among all the courses, the MBA programme is the flagship programme of IIM Raipur, a two-year full-time course comprising six trimesters. Besides, MBA (General) IIM Raipur also offers an executive MBA and Fellow Programme of Management (FPM), a doctoral-level course. IIM Raipur course admission is strictly entrance exam-based.

Candidates eligible for IIM Raipur admission can register themselves through the college's official website. Here are some popular courses of IIM Raipur along with their eligibility, selection criteria and total tuition fees

IIM Raipur Admission Process 2025

For the PGP course (or MBA) admission, candidates with a valid CAT score that matches the cutoff foradmission at IIM Raipurget a seat. Hence, for this flagship course, students need to complete the CAT application process and take the test. For other courses such as MBA Ex, or Certificate, applications can be directly submitted through IIM Raipur's official website. Further, the IIM Raipur admission criteria are explained below:
STEP 1: IIM Raipur Application Process 2025

Indian Institute of Management Raipur application process is carried out in online mode. After the online registration, candidates shall send a copy of the filled form along with all the documents through the post to the institute.
STEP 2: Written Ability Test (WAT)/ Personal Interview (PI) Round

Candidates shortlisted on merit in the CAT entrance test and academic merit have to take the WAT/PI round. Further, a commutative score is calculated for final selections. For the other programmes, students who fulfil theIIM Raipur eligibility criteriaare shortlisted based on course-specific selection criteria.
STEP 3: Proclamation of Final Merit List.
After the IIM Raipur selection criteria are over, the institute can release a merit list in terms of categories.Students who manage to appear on the merit list are allowed admission.
STEP 4: Confirmation of Admission.
The selected applicants are then free to secure their seats with the payment IIM Raipur fee.

faqs.answer: Fellow Programme in Management (FPM) offered by IIM Raipur is a full-time doctoral programme designed in such a way that candidates could enrich themselves in advanced studies and research in different areas of management. Also, candidates who want to build their careers in teaching and research in management studies and for careers in academic institutions and in other organizations can join the FPM course.

faqs.question: Is it easy to get FPM in IIM Raipur?
faqs.answer: Candidates interested in Fellow Programme in Management (FPM) offered by IIM Raipur must appear in any entrance examinations like CAT/ GMAT/ GATE/ GRE/ UGC-NET. The entrance examinations mentioned above are one of the toughest entrance exams having a vast syllabus. Therefore, candidates preparing for these entrance exams must prepare well and try to obtain a good score because having a good score will lead to registering for the personal interview (PI) round.

faqs.question: Can I join FPM at IIM Raipur through a CAT score?
faqs.answer: Yes, IIM Raipur accepts admission in the FPM programme through CAT score. Candidates with a valid CAT scorecard will be shortlisted for the personal interview (PI) round; candidates based on their performance in PI round will be selected for the final admission process, i.e. document verification and fee payment.

faqs.question: How can I get admission at IIM Raipur?
faqs.answer: IIM Raipur offers certification, PG, and doctoral-level management courses. The eligibility criteria for every particular course are different. Given below are theadmission processesfor IIM Raipur coursesMBA:MBA is the flagship programme of IIM Raipur and one of the highly opted courses by students. For admission in the MBA course at IIM Raipur, the candidate should possess a bachelor’s degree in any field with a minimum of 50% (45% for reserved categories) and have a valid CAT score/ percentile to become eligible for the personal interview (PI) round.FPM:Fellow Programme in Management (FPM) is a full-time doctoral course offered by IIM Raipur. Candidates planning to pursue FPM from IIM Raipur should have either a Post-Graduation degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate (45% for reserved categories) or have a CA/ICWA degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate, or have done BTech with a minimum of 6.5 CGPA on a scale of 10 and should have a valid score/ rank of any on these entrance exams lik

faqs.question: Is it hard to get into IIM Raipur?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the MBA programme at IIM Raipur must meet the overall and section-wise CAT percentile. According to cut-off details of IIM Raipur for the year 2023, candidates having overall and section-wise CAT percentile equal to or above 90 were eligible for admission to the MBA programme.Hence, students are advised to give equal importance to all the sections, i.e. verbal ability and reading comprehension (VARC), data interpretation and logical reasoning (DILR) and quantitative aptitude (QA) while preparing for the CAT exam to get eligible for admission to the MBA programme at IIM Raipur.

In addition, a total of 116 recruiters visited the campus and 302 offers were made during IIM Raipur MBA placements 2024. The top recruiters during IIM Raipur MBA placements 2024 included Amazon, Accenture and EY .

Other than this, out of the total of 311 registered students , all students were placed during IIM Raipur MBA summer placements for the batch of 2022-24. Moreover, the highest and average stipend offered during IIM Raipur MBA summer placements for the 2022-24 batch stood at INR 3.50 lakh and INR 1.39 lakh for two months, respectively.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Raipur - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: In the first year, students are exposed to all the domains such as Marketing, HR, Operations, Strategy, etc. This helps in building the foundation for all the functional areas of management and provides students with a chance to understand every domain and find their interests. Hostels are single occupancy with attached bathroom and 24 hours hot/cold water facilities. The food provided in our mess is very tasty and menus are different for different days.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Students get single rooms for themselves, and it helps in self-study. The college is located away from the city in the greenery. You also get to enjoy good natural scenery in the college. The quality of food served in the mess is average, but it'll probably change in the coming year.

reviews.review_heading: It provides the best education. It has excellent placements.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides excellent teaching methodology and good placements.

reviews.review_heading: Insider View @ IIM RAIPUR.

Hostel rooms are good, and there is a single allotment with attached bathrooms. Mess food is also pretty good, and they serve two meals, i.e., breakfast and evening snacks.

placement_data.title: IIM Trichy Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IT sector emerged as the top recruiting sector during IIM Trichy placements 2025. The IT sector offered the highest package of around INR 43 LPA during IIM Tiruchirappalli placement 2025.
There was rise in placement opportunities in Pharma, Consulting, Hospitality , Manufacturing and Logistics (MPHL) sectors during PGPM HR placements 2025.
BFSI sector witnessed 10% increase in highest package as compared with 2024. 50% growth in offers was recorded in the MPHL sector in 2025.
In the FMCG and FMCD sector , 27% increase was recorded in top 25% salary package whereas there was consistent growth in Consulting and Media Services sectors during PGPM and PGPM HR placements 2025.
The average package received by PGPM and PGPM HR students in 2025 was INR 19.27 LPA and 17.84 LPA .

hostel.description:
The Institute has separate hostel building for boys and girls. The boys' hostel is called Beryl. All basic amenities have been provided in the rooms. It has a recreation room with indoor games such as table tennis and carom, LCD television. Along with this, there is ample space outside the building for outdoor games. Beryl is also stocked with musical instruments for the music enthusiasts.

Separate girls hostel, on the other hand, is also situated well within the NIT campus. It is located in a picturesque block that is abundantly green and sufficiently well-lit. Among a host of facilities provided are a gymnasium as well as large open spaces that allow for socializing, outdoor activities as well as the celebration of various festivals.

library.description: The Learning Resource Centre (LRC) of the Institute is the center for academic and professional knowledge resources. The LRC also provides access to the leading electronic resources in the areas of business and management through which we will serve the needs of academics as well as practitioners. LRC is powered by RFID Technology to enable hassle-free check-in check-out of documents providing convenience and flexibility of access to the students. The LRC gives access to databases like Capex – CMIE, EMERALD INSIGHT, J-Gate, ProwessIQ, Oxford Online Journals and many more. The LRC has the latest softwares like IBM SPSS, IBM SPSS Modeler, STATA, TURNITIN, NVIVO - 10, LINGO, Eviews and Palisade/Decision Tools Suite

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Swimming Pool, Tennis Court, Hockey Ground, Table Tennis

reviews.review_heading: Postgraduate programme in Human Resources.
reviews.review_text: The atmosphere created a successful mindset for students. It provides hope and confidence in approaching new things. It made students come out of their comfort zones and try new ideas. Clusters of students from all branches jointly participated in various cultural activities.

reviews.review_heading: The college finds successful youth talents.
reviews.review_text: The college usually follows a lot of formalities to maintain its standards at a high level. To concentrate on sports and other activities, and to grow our talent, special sessions for extracurricular activities are arranged. The college is so familiar and so environmentally friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Postgraduate Programme in Management with Human Resources.
reviews.review_text: College is known for its excellence in its infrastructure, with good reports for its consistent performance in all areas. It's easier to approach the higher authorities of the college to discuss anything. The canteen has spacious areas, so it's crowded most of the time.

reviews.review_heading: The management was so good at IIM Trichy.
reviews.review_text: The regulations of the college have changed every four years. There was relaxing seating available in the canteen areas. Canteen areas were handled by the professional contractors, but this changed when there will be a lot of complaints were received from students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is highlighted by its performance.
reviews.review_text: Most resourceful libraries with online and offline collections. Students can use the library whenever they needed. And we won't be afraid of security systems in the college, security cameras are fixed everywhere in the campus area. Also, you can find some good places for relaxing in the canteen portions.

reviews.review_heading: College of national importance.
reviews.review_text: Hostels and classrooms are great. Our college has a green campus, with a large artificial lake and sports complex with facilities for every sport that one would want to play. It also includes gym and swimming pool. LRC is a 5-floor library with all the access to modern research sources.

reviews.review_heading: Indian institute of management, Trichy.
reviews.review_text: Campus Life is as pretty as they come; it equipped with modern technologies, aesthetic architecture and well-decked classrooms. The best of best is our library, where there are plenty of places for group study, such as glass room, ground pods, ground table, etc. It equipped with the latest subscription and publications. There are many students who run clubs and committees so you will not get bored. college is 20 km away from city. The hostel that provides is great; it is spacious and well built,...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and multiple placement opportunities available at this college.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy had excellent infrastructure for the PGPM course. Top-quality facilities were available on the college campus for the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports, medical, etc. for the students on the college campus. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Tiruchirappalli unofficial review.
reviews.review_text: The campus of IIM Trichy is state of the art. The facilities on hand are first class. The library has all the materials and databases, and the classrooms are well-equipped. The school contains a swimming, as well as various other sporting facilities such as basketball, football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best B-schools in India.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy has a state of art campus. The facilities provided are excellent. Classrooms are well-equipped, and the library has all the resources and databases. The campus has its swimming pool, and numerous other sports facilities like basketball, football, cricket are available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, It is the best college, but need to improve in a few aspects.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy has one of the best infrastructures among all second-tier IIMS. All students get a single room equipped with air-conditioners and all facilities. Classrooms and library have very good infrastructure and top of the class facilities. There are mess, sports complex, etc., and many other facilities available here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Trichy - Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli.
reviews.review_text: This campus is relatively new, and it does provide many facilities such as the sports complex, swimming pool, academic blocks, hostels, etc. The learning centre is yet to be opened for usage, and the gym is yet to be built. Hostels are not equipped with basic facilities such as washing machines or room cleaning services which is an issue for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The Best B-School to be in is IIM-T.
reviews.review_text: IIM-T provides students with a state of the art campus with facilities like fully equipped classrooms with seating capacity varying from 100-250; access to numerous sports facilities including swimming pool, floodlight courts for basketball, volleyball, football, cricket, etc. IIM-T has a plethora of books and other learning sources in the state of the art "Learning Resource Center". Hostels are single occupancy, air-conditioned with an attached balcony.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Trichy, The Southernmost IIM.
reviews.review_text: The permanent state-of-the-art campus is spread over 175 acres. It is one of the most modern campuses ever built. It will be the first among all the IIM's to have a 2MW solar power plant to manage its energy requirements. Harward style Horseshoe seating format is there in the classroom which is complemented by multiple types of capacities ranging from 250 to 50 seater arrangement. AC Single rooms are provided in hostels. Learning Resource Center is soon going to be operational to enhance the lea...

reviews.review_heading: New state of the art campus and global learning environment.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy has new State of the Art campus. The campus is around 15 kms away from the city. The campus is installed with all the basic facilities required. We have a full Wi-Fi campus, e learning classrooms, sports complex available with basketball court, badminton, Table tennis, Swimming pool, football and cricket ground. The doctor is available in the campus every alternate days. The new state of the art library is ready but yet to be inaugurated. Each student is given single occupancy room wi...

paragraphs: BDU admission processstarts with registration for the preferred course. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility requirements to apply for admission. The selection for most of the programmes is entrance-based. Below is step-wise admission process for Bharathidasan University:
STEP 1: BDU Application Process 2025

Candidates can collect the prospectus and the application form from the university campus or apply online. Aspirants applying for CDOE courses have to pay an application fee of INR 250 for UG courses, INR 400 for PG and INR 550 for MBA/ MCA. The application fee for PG extension centre courses is INR 500.
STEP 2: Selection

Bharathidasan University selects candidates for most of the UG and PG courses based on merit in the last qualifying exam. For MBA, the university offers admission through TANCET score. CEETA PG score is considered for admission to MTech course of BDU. Besides, PhD admission is also entrance exam. Aspirants selected for PhD are also required to come for an interview round.
STEP 3: Counselling

Once the candidates are selected, they are called for counselling. For MBA and MTech,TANCET CounsellingandCEETA PG Counsellingare done. Aspirants attending university counselling must bring the specified documents for verification. Shortlisted candidates need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

Bharathidasan University fee is a sum of multiple components, such as tuition fee, hostel fee, library deposit, training and exam fee, etc. There are a few components that are one-time payable, while some have to be paid semester-wise or annually, such as tuition fees. hostel.description: Bharathidasan University's hostel has a total of 1460 students staying in the hostels. Among them 694 are boys and 766 are girls. There are separately integrated dining halls for boys and girls. The hostel rooms are provided with fans, good lighting, adequate water facility, recreation centre, playing ground, newspapers and magazines. Each hostel is provided with a television and cable connectivity. Similarly, all the hostels have Wi-Fi facility. The hostels are provided with a good hygienic cooking facility and spacious dining halls. There is 24 hours watch and ward for women’s hostels. Each hostel is provided with hot water facility in the bathrooms. The hostels have grievance redressal Committee and purchase committee which meet once in a month. The hostels are provided with a telephone facility to receive calls from outside.

library.description: Bharathidasan University's library is well furnished with all resources including e-library resources. The Library has separate halls for housing the books, journals, magazines and reference books in addition to a big and well-furnished reading hall. In terms of learning resources, the library has a good collection of books and e-books in addition to subscribing a number of journals and audio-video cassettes. The library has INFLIBNET and DELNET facilities. The UGC Infonet facility helps to access more than 10000 e-resources including thousands of e-journals. Through the university's digital library, the students and faculty members can have access to more than 5000 back volumes and 7000 electronic books.

Electricity is available 24/7 in the hostel. The quality of food needs to be really appreciated. The college website is fully decorated, and students can register very easily. For accommodation, you pay Rs. 39,000 every year.

content.Placements: At the initial period of establishment, there were severe drawbacks in placements, but later they improved to a good level. Notable recruiters included LIC, HDFC, Times of India Group, Chubby, and Cyient. The packages generally ranged between 2.8 and 4.6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Various emergency response and other safety protocols were implemented on the campus. Access IDs and passwords were provided to all students and staff with high-level security measures.
content.Faculty: Good-grade teachers were efficient at reading students through their facial expressions. They never shared any irrelevant information outside the subjects. The core papers were slightly difficult. They focused heavily on them, while the other business papers were much easier.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: This college feels like a school.

content.Placements: Many preferences and priorities are provided to the academics rather than placements. Students with zero backlogs are allowed to perform in training and drives. TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL Technologies, and UST Global are the highest and moderate payable companies, and companies recruit only 32 to 40% of students.
content.Infrastructure: College with uncountable rules and regulations which in turn boost their admission at it's speak. Without any doubt, there would be a lot of rules in the dress code for both the teachers and the students. There are no chances for visiting tours instead, they would plan for educational visits and workshops for academic learning.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Social Work (MSW) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Mar Augusthinose College.

content.Placements: The chances for recruitment kept on increasing yearly due to the raising of such servicing companies in high levels, as the college got connected with companies like Child Rights and You, Wisemonk, Bhumi, Teach for India to seek opportunities in any of these to start our career as a social worker.
content.Infrastructure: Even with the multiple branches, special deserving candidates were provided with scholarship offers. The Master of Social Work course involved a lot of experiential learning, so we kept visiting areas outside the campus often, and the college provided complete support for it.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Zoology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for the M.Sc. in Zoology course.

content.Placements: About 55 percent of students get placed based on our statistics. The highest salary package offered is 7 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. Large companies like Pfizer, Nestled, and Amul visit our campus to recruit students. High-level jobs like ecologist, conservationist, and so forth are made available to students. Just half of the students at our college are given internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has state-of-the-art labs. Hostel amenities are available. We also have a canteen and a mess hall on campus. Pharmacies have a long history. Every year, there are sports events. The stadium is enormous. Our campus is home to the library as well. Classrooms work well.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Very few students that I know have been placed. The highest package was 5 LPA, the lowest was 3 LPA, and the average was 4 LPA. IT companies like Inforpark offer jobs, and a very few got direct jobs in IT companies, at Bangalore. Software developed, and application developed roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and labs were highly developed with every new technology provided. Classrooms were very attractive, which made students focus more. High-quality foods are provided with great extra activities. The timing was also great and very strict so that students could focus more on studies.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Economics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, I have a good experience at SH Thevara.

content.Placements: There are around 75–80% placements at SH. Companies like Deloitte, KPMG, etc., recruit regularly. The average package is 4–4.5 LPA, with the highest reaching 6–7 LPA. There is a strong placement cell support at the college. More than 65% of students receive internships during their 2nd year.
content.Infrastructure: The college is well-maintained and has modern classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The library has all kinds of reading material required for all subjects. Hostel accommodation is clean, but the rent is a bit high. There is a good canteen with decent food, and the college promotes sports and games.

paragraphs: Mahatma Gandhi University admissionsat the University campus usually begin in May every year. The registrations for all the courses close in June every year. It must be noted that the mentioned timeline is as per the past years’ trend. The admission schedule is further published online on the university website (mgu.ac.in). Candidates must follow the schedule to stay updated and not miss out on an important event. The admission process for courses wherein admission isentrance-based, the process involves application form filling, an entrance test, the release of a selection list, and counselling cum seat allotment. Moreover, for courses wherein admission is merit-based, candidates can be admitted directly after the release of the merit list. Find more details on the stages of the admission process in the following sections.
STEP 1: MG University Application Process 2025

TheMGU application processfor most courses on the university campus is conducted through an MGU CAT. Candidates have to register online via the official website of MGU CAT to apply for any of the programmes (www.cat.mgu.ac.in). For registration and other course applications, students can visit mgu.ac.in. Moreover, applications for accepted exams have to be completed through the website of the exam conducting bodies.
STEP 2: MG University Selection Criteria 2025

After the conclusion of the application process, candidates have to go through the course-specific selection rounds.MG University rank listsare released for each course to indicate the names of the selected candidates. For some courses, candidates have to go through a counselling round as well. UG admissions are also done through the Centralised Allotment Process (CAP), ensuring all admissions are done in a transparent manner. These merit lists are published on the MGU official website.
STEP 3: Fee Payment & Admission Confirmation
After the merit list release, candidates may have to pay some amount of the fee to confirm their seat.

facilities: Library: The University Library has a collection of 57,350 books, 2,500 e-books, 2,050 theses and 7,500 bound volumes of journals. In addition to this, the library subscribes to 253 current Indian (169) and Foreign (84) journals, 4 Online Databases and 4 Online Journal Archives.

Hostel: The university provides accommodation for both boys and girls. Basic facilities like security, electricity, water supply, internet, etc. are provided in the hostels. Room reservation and allocation of hostel rooms to students are managed online.

Sports: Students at Mahatma Gandhi University Kottayam have access to a variety of sporting facilities. Fields and grounds for numerous indoor and outdoor sports are included. Basketball, tennis, volleyball, basketball, football, and hockey fields, among other sports.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Union Christian CollegeReviewed on 28 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: This college feels like a school.
reviews.review_text: College with uncountable rules and regulations which in turn boost their admission at it's speak. Without any doubt, there would be a lot of rules in the dress code for both the teachers and the students. There are no chances for visiting tours instead, they would plan for educational visits and workshops for academic learning.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Mar Augusthinose CollegeReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Mar Augusthinose College.
reviews.review_text: Even with the multiple branches, special deserving candidates were provided with scholarship offers. The Master of Social Work course involved a lot of experiential learning, so we kept visiting areas outside the campus often, and the college provided complete support for it.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Maharaja's CollegeReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for the M.Sc. in Zoology course.
reviews.review_text: Our college has state-of-the-art labs. Hostel amenities are available. We also have a canteen and a mess hall on campus. Pharmacies have a long history. Every year, there are sports events. The stadium is enormous. Our campus is home to the library as well. Classrooms work well.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by K.M.M. College of Arts and ScienceReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs were highly developed with every new technology provided. Classrooms were very attractive, which made students focus more. High-quality foods are provided with great extra activities. The timing was also great and very strict so that students could focus more on studies.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Sacred Heart College - SHCReviewed on 13 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Overall, I have a good experience at SH Thevara.
reviews.review_text: The college is well-maintained and has modern classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The library has all kinds of reading material required for all subjects. Hostel accommodation is clean, but the rent is a bit high. There is a good canteen with decent food, and the college promotes sports and games.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by K.M.M. College of Arts and ScienceReviewed on 1 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: College has high placements and college provides add on courses like AI.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities in our college for studying and for other extracurricular activities. We have technical programs, and they are all at their extreme level. Hostels provide security and time limits. All students behave well and have changed their habits nicely.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Kristu Jyoti College of Management and TechnologyReviewed on 23 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with their approach.
reviews.review_text: Very good infrastructure, the department provided good faculty members, a department library, a common library, and a good practical laboratory. Wi-Fi was available, but not for students. Classrooms were good and had proper facilities. The canteen was small, with only snacks, but good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by SJCET - St. Joseph'S College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 15 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College is good in terms of studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not bad compared to other hostels. They are strict in manner. The food quality is good for some items and below average for the rest. This hostel provides Wi-Fi facilities only for laptops, and mobile Wi-Fi facility is not provided.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by St. Thomas College of Teacher Education, ThodupuzhaReviewed on 12 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely great college that I would recommend.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure felt top-tier and modern. The classrooms are great. The labs are always equipped with what we need, and the Wi-Fi is surprisingly reliable everywhere. There are canteens in every block, so you never had to walk far for food, and the hostel food was actually healthy. They are serious about sports, and the medical facilities are always available, which is reassuring.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by St Teresa's CollegeReviewed on 12 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: This is the best college for M.Com. Course.
reviews.review_text: This college boasts the best hotels and facilities in all of India, as you can clearly observe. You may also look it up on Google, and you will undoubtedly be shocked. About 200 acres make up this college's vast land area, which is home to numerous laboratories and sizable lots. Additionally, this college has separate residence halls for males and females as well as a gymnasium for students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Rajagiri College of Social SciencesReviewed on 9 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Rajagiri College of Social Sciences.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility was available at reasonable prices. Facilities were good. There were rooms available with shared as well as single registration for the hostel. The mess food was good and hygienic.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Kristu Jyoti College of Management and TechnologyReviewed on 6 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: This college is the best.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is good. The amenities offered are quite wonderful if we stay at the college dorms. There are conveniences like hot water and Wi-Fi. The rooms are excellent. Students enrolled in the same subject are housed in the same room. Every month, the dormitory warden and parents have a conversation.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Kristu Jyoti College of Management and TechnologyReviewed on 5 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: This college is the best for placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs and lecture halls are excellent and have good ventilation. There are cozy chairs and tables throughout the hotel. Additionally, there is a reasonably priced canteen and dining room. There is a study space, which includes a shared area and a climate-controlled reading room. There are CCTV surveillance cameras and employees who provide security.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by SJCET - St. Joseph'S College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 5 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good college in terms of studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not bad when compared to other colleges. This hostel is well cleaned every day and maintained. And it provides Wi-Fi facility for laptops. The quality of food is average. Students are allowed to play after college for a restricted time up to 6:30.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by SJCET - St. Joseph'S College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 5 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college is good for studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not as bad as other colleges' hostels, and it is cleaned every day, especially the toilets. The food is not very good, but good on some days and bad on other days, it depends. Sports can be played in a fixed time range.

faqs.question: How is the interview process at IIM Ranchi for MBA?

The personal interview round is conducted to assess the candidate’s leadership skills, subject knowledge, problem-solving skills and communication abilities.

faqs.question: How is the interview process at IIM Ranchi for MBA?
faqs.answer: The interview process of IIM Ranchi is held under CAP (common admission process). The candidates who qualify for CAT are further invited to the personal interview round. The PI is conducted virtually and exact dates and information for the same is communicated to the shortlisted candidates in due course. The personal interview round is conducted to assess the candidate’s leadership skills, subject knowledge, problem-solving skills and communication abilities.

faqs.question: What is the minimum CAT percentile for IIM Ranchi?
faqs.answer: The minimum CAT percentile for IIM Ranchi is around 93. The percentile may ranges between 40 to 75 for the categories such as NC-OBC, ST, SC, etc.Candidate a must qualify the CAT exam to get admission to the MBA programme. Candidates must visit the IIM Ranchi official website to register their candidature and pay the required application fee. The aspirants must have a valid scorecard of the CAT entrance test accepted by IIM Ranchi for admission to a particular course.The candidates must fill out and submit the form before IIM Ranchi last date to apply and also the candidates are advised to check the eligibility criteria of the course before starting the IIM Ranchi registration process.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to IIM Ranchi?
faqs.answer: No, IIM Ranchi does not provide direct admissions to any of the IIM Ranchi courses. The institute has a predefined admission process that all candidates need to follow.The first stage includes meeting the eligibility criteria. Candidates can check eligibility for all courseshere. After matching the eligibility criteria, the candidate has to appear for the respective entrance examination.Note: Admission to Executive MBA is done through Personal Interview only. The candidates are not required to appear for any entrance exam.The candidates who are able to meet the cut-off are then communicated for the second round which is a PI (Personal Interview) round.The final stage includes admission offers for IIM Ranchi, based on a Consolidated Merit List (CML), which is generally prepared based on entrance exam scores, personal interview scores, and academic profile.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to IIM Ranchi?
faqs.answer: Candidates are required to take theCommon Admission Test (CAT)to gain admission to the flagship programme,MBA in General Management, at IIM Ranchi. The CAT also serves as the entrance exam for theMBA-HRandMBA in Business Analyticsprogrammes offered by the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ranchi. To proceed with the admission process, candidates must meet the sectional cutoff and overall cutoff. Once they achieve the necessary CAT percentile, the shortlisted candidates will be notified of the specific dates for their Personal Interviews.For admission to theExecutive MBAprogramme of IIM Ranchi, candidates have to go through thePersonal Interview (PI)process only, the candidate must have at least 5 years of full-time work experience to be eligible for this programme.

A total of 81 companies visited the campus during MBA placements 2025. For MBA HR and MBA BA programs, 26 and 34 companies participated in 2025. Leading recruiters such as EY, Amazon, Deloitte and ICICI Bank visited the campus in 2025.
MBA students received the highest stipend at INR 3 lakh and average stipend at INR 1.3 lakh. The MBA HR, highest stipend was s INR 3.6 lakh and the average at INR 1.58 lakh .

The hotel is located in the Khelgaon Housing Association and has good facilities. The classroom is likewise outfitted with all necessary amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Mandatory to show concern for all the activities.
reviews.review_text: There will be certain limitations for the students in eating hostel food. We should visit the hostel lounges at the proper time to have our meals, breakfast, and dinner. Hostel warden won't mind the activity of students in the hostel rooms. But if we had created any problems, we were watched strictly.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Ranchi has the best quality facilities, faculty, and placement opportunities for its students.
reviews.review_text: IIM Ranchi had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had the best quality facilities on the campus for the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, mess, hostel, sports, medical, and all other modern facilities were available in the college for the students. Hostel facilities were also of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: The feel of this college is high, but it is worth it for its quality education.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is very great and nice. The overall environment is also nice. There is a swimming pool and playground on the campus. Classrooms are big, and a gym facility is also available. The hostel is separate, and the security is also strict for both boys and girls. Good food in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi – Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good as per the fee taken for them, rooms are provided on a sharing basis that includes two sharing and three sharing as well. Food facilities are good, with a large variety of food provided in the mess. The hostels are well supplied with proper electricity, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfying faculty and infrastructure, brilliant crowd but high fees.
reviews.review_text: Hostels and mess food are in accordance with the high fees, but the college is newly made, so certain things are underdeveloped, such as the playground, community area, and some other buildings. College management is not that effective; otherwise, the campus is beautiful and serves its purpose.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth the high fees because of the knowledgeable professors and diverse crowd.
reviews.review_text: Basic facilities like Wi-Fi, single occupancy rooms, high-tech classrooms, library, and gym are available, but the campus is newly built and not up to par with other Institutes of national importance as it is still under development. Many more buildings are yet to be constructed.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Internet facility is available in all classrooms. Classrooms are well-furnished. It also has podiums, on-seat mic, smart boards, and air-conditioners. Hostels are very good. It has beds, wardrobes, chairs, and tables. Double occupancy rooms are available. Washrooms are good. We also have rented rooms near our campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college for holistic development.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are excellent. Hostels are good. Our campus is beautiful. Playground is available. A swimming pool is also available. There is a gym facility in this college. Our campus is very peaceful and has good environment.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. Hostel is very good. Single occupancy rooms are available. Washrooms are good. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. All facilities are decent. Classrooms are well-maintained. Digital boards are also available in classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. Our classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners and smart boards. The library is equipped with an ever-increasing collection of books of non-fiction and management journals. Students request new books.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, amazing faculty, average infrastructure and facilities, good crowd, good placements.
reviews.review_text: The food quality is very good at IIM Ranchi, they serve tasty and healthy food. Although, as the temporary campus is in a housing society, there are several restrictions for the students. Sports facilities are average, not too good and not too bad. The rooms follow an apartment system which is a big advantage as it's better for privacy and every apartment gets a kitchen.

reviews.review_heading: Really satisfied with the college because of the faculty, good placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The IIM Ranchi was established in 2010 and was operating in a temporary campus at suchna bhawan and the hostels were at khelgaon, however now the new campus is ready to operate the new batches has started operating in the new campus. The campus is in 70 acres. The campus is vertical and the infrastructure is world class. It is equipped with every essential amenities like medical, sports, swimming pool, canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM College Ranchi
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available. No proper classrooms, labs, or libraries were available. The hostel is the best with all facilities and personal room for all students. Food quality was above average. Medical facilities were available. No proper canteen and sports were available.

content.Placements: The placements are decent, but most of the roles are catered to Computer Science students, so there is a dent in placements for Data Science in particular. Top roles often offered being AI/ML engineers, software testers, etc., and if you are good with coding, then it will work for you.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good, but a point to note is that the Wi-Fi does not always work and the network is often very slow in the campus buildings, otherwise, the campus, classrooms. Labs are good, and there are canteens around the campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with good workflow and connectivity across the city.

content.Placements: I am studying BCA at Presidency College, which is a good college in Bangalore. 30 percent of students got placed last year in our course. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. Companies like Accenture, Flipkart, IBM, etc., hire students. The placement record of the college has significantly improved over years. There is a very good placement record among all the other colleges.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not that great. It is a small college. The college does have Wi-Fi and hostel facilities. The college is doing well in sports and games in recent years and offers a variety of different games for every individual who has different interests in many things.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Management (BBM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college has a good education system.

content.Placements: Placements are good. Many companies will come for a placement drive. Many have been selected in the placement drive and secured their first job in fields such as HRM, marketing, sales, and digital marketing. However, it ultimately depends on your skills, confidence, and the way you communicate.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are spacious. There’s proper ventilation, and hygiene is maintained in the washrooms too. We have a library, and it's very useful. Wi-Fi is only for the staff, not for students. There are science labs, an electronics lab, a mathematics lab, and a computer lab. There's also a canteen; overall, the infrastructure is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Facilities are not good in our college.

content.Placements: No companies came for placement. Only a few came, and they were low-level companies. Guess what, college bought an agency for providing us placement for 2 LPA. Better to join somewhere else, at least those which provide placements.
content.Infrastructure: Don’t know about hostel, but friends are staying, and it is like a pure jail, no freedom. Also, the infrastructure as of now is very average. New buildings are not good. Currently, new buildings are constructed, but as of now, it’s very average.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Cyber Security - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of the Cyber Security department at UVCE.

content.Placements: About 95 percent of students got placed from our department last year. Top companies like TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, and Tech Mahindra come for recruitment. The highest package offered is 10 LPA, and the average package offered is 4.5 LPA. The university provides 100 percent internships in different companies.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in our course are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available in the class and labs. Wi-Fi is also available in the hostel, but with limited data. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped with AC. The hostel and mess food are adjustable. A paid canteen is also available. Medical facilities are available all the time.

faqs.answer: Yes, the university offers two-year MBA course in a full-time and part-time mode. There are 74 colleges affiliated to the Bangalore University that offer this programme. faqs.question: How can I get admission in Bangalore University MBA?
faqs.answer: Aspirants shall first check the eligibility criteria to ensure they fulfil the requirement. Eligible candidates can further submit the application online by visiting the official website of Bangalore University (bangaloreuniversity.ac.in). The university selects candidates for this course based on merit in the Karnataka PGCET entrance test (for CBSMS), followed by a counselling round. The university also accepts KMAT/CAT/MAT/PGCET/CMAT/XAT/ATMA/GMAT/NMAT scores.

faqs.question: What is the MBA course fee at Bangalore University?

faqs.question: Who is eligible for MCA in Bangalore University?
faqs.answer: Candidates who fulfil the educational requirements as prescribed by the university become eligible for admission. For eligibility, the aspirant shall be a graduate with a valid BCA/BSc/BCom/BA degree and should have studied Mathematics as one of the subjects in Class 12 or at graduation. Candidates seeking admission to the MCA Lateral course, should have a degree in Science or applied Science (three-year) in computer applications/computer science/information technology or other computer-related

faqs.question: Can I do MCA without an entrance exam from Bangalore University?
faqs.answer: No, Bangalore University MCA admission is completely entrance-based. However, the University also offers direct entry to the six semesters of the MCA course. To be eligible for the lateral entry, candidates must have a degree in Science or applied Science of three-year duration in Computer Applications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or other computer-related areas. Aspirants can get in touch with the admission office for more details.

faqs.question: I have scored less than 50% in graduation. Can I get admission in MCA at Bangalore University?
faqs.answer: Bangalore University offers a two-year postgraduate degree in MCA. The basic eligibility to apply forBangalore University MCA programmeis to pass graduation with a minimum aggregate of 50% from a recognised university. Hence, those who have scored less than 50% in their Bachelor's are not eligible to apply for the course. However, the candidates can decide to pursue MCA in distance mode. Candidates can also go for one of the colleges offeringonline MCA courses.

faqs.question: What percentage is required for Bangalore University?
faqs.answer: Candidates who wish to get admission to Bangalore University courses should have secured min. 40% to 50% aggregate in Class 12 or the last exam. The required aggregate depends upon the course. Moreover, for courses where admission is entrance-based, a good exam score is required. Bangalore University announces cutoff marks for each course. There are multiple factors affecting the cutoff marks. The main factors that are considered while releasing cutoffs are:Previous year cutoff marksTotal no.of participantsTotal no.of seats availableThe difficulty level of the entrance tests, read more aboutBU Cutoff

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility for taking admission in various UG and PG courses at Bangalore University?
faqs.answer: To take admission in UG courses, students must clear Class 12 from a recognised board. Final selection is made on the basis of the entrance examination conducted by the university or merit in Class 12. For PG courses, candidates need to have a valid bachelor’s degree in the relevant field from Karnataka University or an equivalent university. It is also imp that the students has passed the qualifying examination with the required aggregate as prescribed by the authorities. Further, the final selection criteria vary from course to course.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to MCA at Bangalore University?
faqs.answer: Bangalore University MCA admission is based on Karnataka PGCET score. Candidates seeking admission to the MCA course must visit the University’s official website (bangaloreuniversity.ac.in) to register themselves. After successful registration, aspirants must appear for thePGCETentrance test. The university further announces the results and the shortlisted candidates following which seat allotment is carried out.

nirf.description:
Bangalore University has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for Bangalore University indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. When evaluated against the ranking of the past years, it has been noticed that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend. In 2025, Bangalore University's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been noticed that in the 'University' category, the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared against previous year's ranking. In 2025, Bangalore University climbed 16 ranks to #65 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
The institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'State Public University' category when compared with the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Bangalore University fell 2 ranks to #26 rank in the 'State Public University' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Kristu Jayanti UniversityReviewed on 21 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Above average and decent college, value for money.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, but a point to note is that the Wi-Fi does not always work and the network is often very slow in the campus buildings, otherwise, the campus, classrooms. Labs are good, and there are canteens around the campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Presidency CollegeReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good workflow and connectivity across the city.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not that great. It is a small college. The college does have Wi-Fi and hostel facilities. The college is doing well in sports and games in recent years and offers a variety of different games for every individual who has different interests in many things.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Jindal First Grade College For WomenReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college has a good education system.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are spacious. There’s proper ventilation, and hygiene is maintained in the washrooms too. We have a library, and it's very useful. Wi-Fi is only for the staff, not for students. There are science labs, an electronics lab, a mathematics lab, and a computer lab. There's also a canteen; overall, the infrastructure is good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Christ Academy Institute for Advanced StudiesReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Facilities are not good in our college.
reviews.review_text: Don’t know about hostel, but friends are staying, and it is like a pure jail, no freedom. Also, the infrastructure as of now is very average. New buildings are not good. Currently, new buildings are constructed, but as of now, it’s very average.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering, Bangalore UniversityReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Review of the Cyber Security department at UVCE.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in our course are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available in the class and labs. Wi-Fi is also available in the hostel, but with limited data. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped with AC. The hostel and mess food are adjustable. A paid canteen is also available. Medical facilities are available all the time.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Excellent placement support.
reviews.review_text: It has well-maintained classrooms with smartboards and a fully equipped library, wi-fi is a bit slow, and modern computer labs that support effective learning. It provides professions environment with seminar halls, project labs, well organized academic facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Review of International institute of Business Studies.
reviews.review_text: We have very good infrastructure and facilities like a library, computer lab, canteen, classrooms, and seminar halls. Every room has a Wi-Fi facility. The college is surveilled with CCTV cameras. It provides all the basic facilities required in a college. Overall, the infrastructure is good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 13 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Overall, it’s just a normal, average college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. The college looks like a coaching center rather than a large campus. Events are sometimes held in corridors or the gallery. Classrooms are good, well-ventilated, and air-conditioned. Hostel facilities are basic, with food being just average, but manageable.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 13 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good placements and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college provides us with Wi-Fi, smart board, and library for student use, and laptops are given. The college has exchange programs and interactive sessions. The college gives hostel facility as well for 1 year, and transport is provided as well for a price.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Kristu Jayanti UniversityReviewed on 11 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It's the best for some students and a drawback for some.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our university is amongst the top, as they are trying to provide us with everything as much as possible. The hostel facilities are not up to the mark because there is a lot of shortage in everything. Other than that, we have good labs, classrooms, and libraries.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering, Bangalore UniversityReviewed on 9 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Marvelous. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good and knowledgeable; they teach very well which is easily understood. Infrastructure of our college is very beautiful and wide, which has many spots to explore. Many courses and departments are there to choose from. Classrooms are also good, well cleaned, along with a big library. Hostel facilities are also satisfactory because it consists of all essential needs.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 9 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Small infrastructure with extensive knowledge and scope.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is small but has all the facilities related to study. Wi-Fi works fine, and there are 2 computer labs and also Bloomberg terminals, with which you can get certification. There are two libraries. I don’t know about the quality of the hostel and food.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 9 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good academics with decent placements and supportive faculty - IIBS college review 2026.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have centralized ACs, and the students are extremely comfortable with the libraries and hostel, where we can expect good food and hygiene. Sports are conducted every academic year. Apart from that, indoor games are always available on the campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by International Institute of Business StudiesReviewed on 9 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: A real PGDM experience at IIBS Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The campus is neat with good classrooms, a library, and common spaces. Life here is balanced-while academics are rigorous, cultural events, management fests, and clubs make it engaging. It is a good environment to build a peer network and learn teamwork. A new reading room has been allotted, and we have digital library access.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: The placements are impressive and Ttaching quality is very high.

review_content.Placements: The placements are impressive, with 100% placements. For 2020-22, the average package was 16.61 LPA, the median was 16 LPA and the highest package was 22 LPA. More than 50 recruiters were there, some of them being Axtria, Tiger Analytics, Emphasis, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley, Accenture, and Juspay visit, offering different profiles including Analytics, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and IT/Consulting. Summer Internships are also 100%.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great at IME, IIT Kanpur, with state-of-the-art classrooms and hostels. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Mess food is good, unlike many colleges, and canteens and other eateries are also available. Facility for almost every sport is available on campus - Badminton, football, tennis, squash, cricket, volleyball, basketball, and table tennis. Medical facility is also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with MBA at IIT Kanpur.

review_content.Placements: Placements commence for us in 3rd semester and there is a 100% placement mostly. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria etc. Visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum and averages about 16/annum. I plan to join a company through campus placements only.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library is clearly the best one in the country! Classrooms are top-notch, and there are a plethora of options for sports and extra-curricular activities. Hostels are very affordable and the registration process is pretty hassle-free.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.

content.Placements: Placements commence for us in the 3rd semester, and there is a 100% placement rate. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria, etc., visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum, and the average is about 16 lac/annum. For internships, companies like ICICI Bank and Emphasis visit. The roles offered are diverse, from Data Analyst to Product Management, and the total stipend ranges from 1-200,000 for most internships. It gives the students very good industry exposure.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

content.Placements: This college provides every student with placement facilities, but one condition is that a 7 CGPA is compulsory in your qualification degree. Many technology companies offer internships through the college and provide salaries ranging from 9 LPA to 25 LPA per annum.
content.Infrastructure: The college’s infrastructure quality is very good and provides the best facilities such as a library, classrooms, bathrooms, labs, gymkhana, water drinking machines, computers, lift elevators, etc. The college canteen serves very tasty food that tastes like home-made food.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The placements are impressive and Ttaching quality is very high.

content.Placements: The placements are impressive, with 100% placements. For 2020-22, the average package was 16.61 LPA, the median was 16 LPA and the highest package was 22 LPA. More than 50 recruiters were there, some of them being Axtria, Tiger Analytics, Emphasis, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley, Accenture, and Juspay visit, offering different profiles including Analytics, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and IT/Consulting. Summer Internships are also 100%.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great at IME, IIT Kanpur, with state-of-the-art classrooms and hostels. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Mess food is good, unlike many colleges, and canteens and other eateries are also available. Facility for almost every sport is available on campus - Badminton, football, tennis, squash, cricket, volleyball, basketball, and table tennis. Medical facility is also available.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with MBA at IIT Kanpur.

content.Placements: Placements commence for us in 3rd semester and there is a 100% placement mostly. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria etc. Visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum and averages about 16/annum. I plan to join a company through campus placements only.
content.Infrastructure: The library is clearly the best one in the country! Classrooms are top-notch, and there are a plethora of options for sports and extra-curricular activities. The fest committees are run by students only. The rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good and taken well care of. Hostels are very affordable and the registration process is pretty hassle-free.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Great faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: The placements here for MBA are good, more than 80% of the students got placed. Various well known companies visited the campus for placements such as TATA, OYO, Godrej, Punjab National Bank etc. The highest package offered this year (2022) was 20LPA and the average package was 14 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The experience on the college campus is great and life-changing. The library named PK Kelkar library has a large number of books for every field. The classes have air conditioners and projectors for better teaching. The college provides opportunities to learn different sports and extracurricular activities and showcase your talents in different competitions. In hostel, there was fan, B.Ed study table, chair and a small window in my room. I used to have my food in the mess. The food was satisfactory and the menu was good too. We had non-veg only on Monday and Friday. Registration was done hand to hand and hostel fee was quite affordable. The hostel fee I gave for one semester was 13.5k.

admission_overview.college_name: IMT Ghaziabad Admission 2025 (Open): Courses, Fee, Eligibility & Selection, Application

paragraphs: Institute of Management Technology Ghaziabad admission window 2025 is open. The institute provides PG programmes under the management stream. IMT Ghaziabad admissions are based on entrance tests. Candidates must possess a valid score in the course-related entrance exam for admission. Applicants who are interested in pursuing the Degree of PGDM need to complete the eligibility requirement of IMT Ghaziabad that includes graduation in any course, with an aggregate percentage of 50 and valid CAT/XAT/GMAT scorecard.
The applications of ineligible candidates are treated as invalid. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularIMT Ghaziabad courses:
Eligibility Criteria
Selection Criteria
3-year bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate
CAT/XAT/GMAT+ Personal Interview + Work Experience + Academic Scores
Master's degree or equivalent in any discipline with at least 60% aggregate OR
Five-year integrated master's degree programme with a minimum of 60% aggregate OR
Graduation with a professional qualification - CA/CMA/CS
CAT/GMAT/GRE/UGC-NET

Aspirants will make sure that they present the applications prior to the last date of IMT Ghaziabad form. Moreover, the process of admission is a multi-stage process that includes online registration, filling the application form, selection rounds and allocating seats. The information on each of the stages of the admission procedure is presented below in more detail:
Step 1: IMT Ghaziabad 2025 Application Process.

Application forms of IMT Ghaziabad are through the online method. The official site (www.IMT.edu) allows qualified applicants to enroll themselves to the preferred course. In order to be successful in submitting the application form, the payment of the fee should be completed in time. IMT Ghaziabad charges are in INR 3,500 and the bank charges. The exam score accepted is also needed during the form filling process.
Step 2: Shortlisting of Students.

The institute selects candidates to admission as per the score in accepted IMT Ghaziabad exam ( CAT/XAT/GMAT-PGDM, and CAT/GMAT/GRE/UGC-NET- FPM). A cut off list may be issued to declare the lowest marks which will qualify one to join the respective course. Applicants with a mark that is at least equivalent to the cutoff marks can be selected in the rounds.
Step 3: Personal Interview and Selective Rounds.

The shortlisted applicants must undergo the interview round in both FPM and the PGDM course admission. Moreover, in the case of IMT Ghaziabad PGDM admission, the other criteria upon which selection is made are the work experience of the candidate, academic performance, ability to think critically, and unbiasedness in terms of education.
Step 4: Result Declaration
The institute announces the final results after all the selection rounds. The candidates will have access to the results checked online on the official website of the institute.

faqs.question: Are admissions open for Punjab Agricultural University?
faqs.answer: Yes,admissions are open for Punjab Agricultural University Ludhiana. Students lookint to take admission may apply for the same at the official website of the university. The university shortlists students on an entrance basis for most of the courses. Interested candidates need to check the admission criteria of the desired course and apply for the same. For any questions students can reach out to the university's admission help desk.

faqs.question: How do I get admission to Punjab Agricultural University?
faqs.answer: PAU Ludhiana admission is done on the basis of clearance of the preset admission criteria. As admissions to most of the courses are entrance-based, students have to clear the accepted exam. Students are shortlisted based on multiple factors, such as entrance exam scores, past academic performance, and more. For UG, PG, and PhD admissions, students are selected based on entrance exam scores. The university accepts BSET, AAT, ICAR AIEEA, and other national-level entrance exams. Seat allotment is done through university's counselling process. For final confirmation, admission fees need to be paid.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, Punjab Agricultural University outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have dropped in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, Punjab Agricultural University fell 1 rank to #81 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Punjab Agricultural University fell 7 ranks to #64 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It can be seen that; in the 'State Public University' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, Punjab Agricultural University climbed 2 ranks to #28 rank in the 'State Public University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Agriculture and Allied Sectors' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability when compared with previous year's ranking. In 2025, Punjab Agricultural University's rank is #3, the same as last year's rank in the 'Agriculture and Allied Sectors' category by the NIRF ranking.
