reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfactory university.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available but the some hostel which is given to first year students is average, and that hostel has 3S rooms. But in second year another hostel is allotted to students, and that are too good than that of 1st year, and that hostel has big rooms.

reviews.review_heading: PAU is full of opportunities and research.
reviews.review_text: The university is very big and it comprises many different colleges. The campus is spread over 1,600 acers. Classrooms are also fully furnished and all studies are done by projector PPT based. It has one of the biggest libraries in Punjab. Hostels are in liveable conditions and not very lavish.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied hostels but the great campus life and placement at PAU.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the institution is good, but the hostels are in poor condition. Some renovation work has now been initiated, so we hope for improvements soon. The Wi-Fi system functions well, classes are engaging, and the mess food is satisfactory—there have been no issues in that regard. Additionally, the sports facilities are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2023, highly cooperative faculty.
reviews.review_text: The campus has Wi-Fi in the library and other academic buildings. The infrastructure of the college is not very complex; a simple building consists of classrooms and labs in the UG building, while the PG building has all the teacher cabins. I am a day scholar, but the hostels have rooms in considerably poor condition, and the washrooms seriously need renovation.

reviews.review_heading: Everything about the College of Agricultural Engineering and PAU is positive.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are really not good, but the mess food is awesome. Classes are good, but in summer they are exhausting because they don’t have AC in the classrooms. Otherwise, there is a problem of leakage in some classes. Some creativity is also shown in the classrooms as the infrastructure is unique.

reviews.review_heading: BTech in Food technology at Punjab agricultural University Ludhiana.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are clean and well maintained. Most rooms on the premises are air-conditioned and well furnished. We are provided with a 24-hour library facility. We can study for the whole night as well in time of exams. The library is air conditioned as well. We have various departments for each subject for the practical knowledge about the particular subject. Our hostels are clean and fully furnished. We are provided a bed, an almirah, a study table and a chair. Washrooms are common on each fl...

reviews.review_heading: PAU- one of the best state agriculture university.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. The university has play grounds, library, cafe, hotel, etc. Hostels have wi-fi and the rooms are also clean. university has its own hospital, where treatment is free for students. Classrooms have projectors and lawns have all the required equipments.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best agriculture engineering colleges in India with really good placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is satisfactory and hostels are also okay, as all the hostels in government universities are same but mess is really good; non-vegetarians are served 3 days in mess and the average mess bill is around 4-5k per person if he eats regularly. Classrooms are not provided with ACs.

reviews.review_heading: It is Asia's top-ranked university in the field of agriculture.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are well-equipped with projectors, podiums, mikes, and water coolers. It has the best labs in India. PCR machines, water baths, refractometers, photometers, and many more are available in our college. Library has every book and students can access them. Free Wi-Fi is provided after filling out the Wi-Fi form. Hostels are in very good condition and the food served is very good as our college takes strict action against a healthy diet. Many canteens are available. They serve Maggi, sh...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for this course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. There are separate hostels for UG and PG students. There is also a separate hostel for international students. Girls' hostels are closed after 7:00 PM and they have separate blocks within the hostels. Wi-Fi is available. Library is well-equipped. Several books are available in our library. Hospital facilities are available 24X7. It has separate courts for games.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placements last year, good infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure having all the facilities like washrooms, Wi-Fi, canteens, individual book banks for all different departments. Have Asia's the largest library in the campus. Labs with international class equipments. But hostels are not so good, old buildings with a lot of damages. Quality of food in mess is average. Medical facilities are also not so good. Great infrastructure for sports but no so good coaches. You'll have both the options for NSO and NSS. You'll have all hockey stadium, cr...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure but placements are not good.
reviews.review_text: The food served in the hostel is good. Hostel rooms need renovation as there is various issue that needs to be tackled. Laboratory is well-furnished, and it has all the required equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Punjab Agricultural University has good campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. Our campus is clean. Laboratories are also available. Playground is also provided for sports. Our college surroundings are green.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PAU, Ludhiana.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Some hostels are also very neat and clean, but the old hostels like hostel-1 and the old girls' hostel have poor quality facilities. Hostels have 2 seater and 4 seater rooms. There are coolers but not AC in rooms. Hostels are very affordable. It has a garden, canteen, mess, television room, and a table tennis room. In the mess, the food quality is above average. There is a proper weekly menu for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Sweets are provided alon...

reviews.review_heading: I am quite satisfied with the university.
reviews.review_text: Very efficient facilities are provided for study. There is a projector in every classroom. Moreover, there are various labs for practical work which have all the required equipment like microscopes, incubators, autoclaves, laminar airflow, etc. Apart from this, a Wi-Fi facility is available in hostels. Libraries have an air conditioning system, so students can study effectively.

review_content.General: The campus is newly built with all modern amenities. The vicinity in which the campus is located is quite desolate. Facilities are still under construction, so constant construction noise disturbs. The location is very far from the main city, with limited options for cabs and online orders. Networks like Airtel have issues on campus, but the newly built library has all study materials. paragraphs: IIM Visakhapatna admission process 2025is ongoing, and the Interview calls will be out soon.IIM Vizag admission 2025is entirely entrance-based as the institute accepts the scores and percentile scores of various entrance examinations such as CAT/ GMAT/GRE/ IIMV Test, etc. for admission in various courses. For admission to PGP, candidates are shortlisted based on the valid CAT scores, which match the cutoff for admission at IIM Vizag. For other programme likePhDandPGPEX, applications can be directly submitted through IIM Visakhapatnam website. IIM Vizag admission is conducted in phase wise manner. Find below theIIM Vizag admission process 2025:
STEP 1: IIM Visakhapatnam Application Process 2025

Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam application processis carried out in online mode. Candidates need to completeCAT registrationon iimcat.ac.in for admission to PGP, EMBA and PGPDGM programmes. For PhD and PGPEx courses, applications are accepted via IIM Vizag's official website. Once theCAT resultsare announced, candidates are required to fill out a detailed online application form separately for theIIM Vizag MBA course.
STEP 2: Personal Interview

Candidates who fill out the online application form and meet the minimum percentile will be considered as 'Qualified Confirmed Candidates'. IIM Visakhapatnam will then calculate the weighted scores based on CAT, Class 10, Class 12, Bachelor's degree, Diversity and Wok Experience and will give the Interview calls and candidates will then be required to appear for the Personal Interview round. The interview round for the For PhD, PGPEX and PGPDGM programme is conducted after the release of the selection list.
STEP 3: Final Selection

IIM Vizag will then calculate the 'Final Aggregate Score' based on various parameters like Personal Interview, CAT, Class 10, Class 12, Bachelor's degree, Diversity and Work Experience and will give the final shortlist for MBA/ PGP.

The final selection for various programmes is based on certain parameters including CAT/ GMAT/GRE/ IIMV Test, Diversity, Technical Knowledge and Domain Experience, SOP, Professional References and Personal Interview scores.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation
The selected candidates can confirm their seats/ admission by paying the required amount ofIIM Visakhapatnam MBA fees.

Note:Candidates who are shortlisted and interviewed by IIMs Bangalore, Kozhikode, Lucknow or Indore (only for their PGP/ PGPM programme) will not be required to appear for the Personal Interview at IIM Vizag. For these candidates, the average of their Personal Interview scores from the aforementioned IIMs will be used to calculate their Personal Interview score for IIM Visakhapatnam. IIM Vizag admission to the MBA or PGP is entirely based on CAT exam score and percentile. CAT is a highly competitive exam that is a must have to get into the IIMs and other top management colleges in India. A well planned strategy along with the right approach is essential for admission to PGP at IIM Visakhapatnam.Read moreabout the CAT preparation strategy.

faqs.question: What is the process to get admission for MBA in IIM Visakhapatnam?
faqs.answer: For admission to PGP at IIM Visakhapatnam, candidates are shortlisted based on the valid CAT scores. IIM Vishakhapatnam admission is conducted in phase wise manner. Find below theIIM Vishakhapatnam admission process 2025:STEP 1:IIM Visakhapatnam application process is carried out in online mode. Candidates need to complete CAT registration for admission to PGP. Once the CAT exam results are announced, candidates are required to fill out detailed online application form separately for IIM Vishakhapatnam MBA admission.STEP 2:Candidates who fill out the online application form and meet the minimum percentile will be considered as 'Qualified Confirmed Candidates'. IIM Visakhapatnam then calculate the weighted scores based on CAT, Class 10, Class 12, Bachelor's degree, Diversity and Wok Experience and will give the Interview calls and candidates will then be required to appear for the Personal Interview round.STEP 3:IIM Vishakhapatnam then calculate the 'Final Aggregate Score' based on vari

faqs.question: What is the common admission procedure at IIM Visakhapatnam?
faqs.answer: Like any other management institute,IIM Visakhapatnam admissionis entirely based on CAT scores for PGP. Candidates have to follow the CAT admission procedure. Whereas, for courses like PGPEX and PhD application can be directly submitted through IIM Visakhapatnam official website. Candidates are then shortlisted for the Interview based on overall profile. The final selection in other programmes offered at IIM Vizag will be made based on a composite score comprising the performance in CAT/ GMAT/ GRE/ IIMV Test, Diversity, Technical Knowledge and Domain Experience, SOP, Professional References and Personal Interview score.

faqs.question: What is the CAT cut off for IIM Vizag?
faqs.answer: IIM Visakhapatnamaccepts CAT scores for admission to the management courses. However, the institute does not release the CAT cutoffs in the public domain and is exclusively accessible only via account login to candidates who have appeared for the exam. IIMs accept both sectional and overall cutoff for admission.CAT2024 cutoff will be tentatively declared in the month of Jan. Considering the previous year trends, the final CAT cutoff 2024 is expected to be in the range between 92-94 for IIM Visakhapatnam.The estimated qualifying CAT cutoff 2024 is 80 for the General category students.

reviews.review_heading: An overview of IIM Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: A hostel is mandatory for every student. The best hostel facility is available on campus. Single-sharing room with AC, beds, and almirah. Study lamps and everything else that will be necessary for the next two years. All hostels have mesmerizing scenic views from their windows. Fridges, washing machines, induction, and clothing drying areas are available on every floor. Food is good in comparison to other foods. Breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner are being provided, as well as special food on s...

reviews.review_heading: Indian institute of management Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: The campus is newly built with all modern amenities. The vicinity in which the campus is located is quite desolate. Facilities are still under construction, so constant construction noise disturbs. The location is very far from the main city, with limited options for cabs and online orders. Networks like Airtel have issues on campus, but the newly built library has all study materials. I receive a single occupancy room with AC, fan, almirah, cupboard, mattress, a 7-foot-long mirror, a whiteboard...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very impressive for our courses and departments. 24*7 Wi-Fi is present, labs, classrooms, and the library are fine; there are no other words. Yes, the hostel is pretty good. The mess provides very hygienic varieties of food, although it is costly. Medical facilities and sports/games are available.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Visakhapatnam is a perfect place to pursue a financial degree.
reviews.review_text: As we all know, IIM campuses were well-equipped with all the future amenities. I really miss my campus a lot. The infrastructure of classrooms and hostels were excellent and maintained in a proper and neat manner. The food available was great and hygienic, and all facilities like sports, a medical center, and a supermarket were present inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: College placement is very good.
reviews.review_text: Samaarambh is the annual cultural fest of IIM Visakhapatnam and is conducted in the month of February. There are a lot of books on Managerial subjects available in the library if someone wants to do an in-depth study other than the course material which is provided to them. Other than that there are journals, newspapers and magazines available as well. Even biographies of famous and successful personalities. The classrooms are tidy and have 2 Televisions, and 2 Projectors to view presentations a...

reviews.review_heading: About the campus of Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: I am overwhelmed to share the infrastructure and facilities of IIM Visakhapatnam. It's a beautiful space fully filled with beautiful souls and good vibes only. Events are arranged in great manner, and the students from other colleges participate in such events.

paragraphs: IIM Vizag offers scholarship to the candidates who are financial instable, with an objective of helping candidates to pursue their education. All PGP students with annual household income below INR 6,00,000 are eligible to apply for financial aid. Other students with severe financial difficulties arising from sudden unforeseen circumstances are also considered.A two-step process is included in deciding the number of awardees and the quantum of aid. paragraphs: Dibrugarh University offers admission on the basis ofmeritandentrance examscores. The university offers courses in streams like Commerce, Engineering, Social Science, etc. These courses are offered at the undergraduate, post graduate, and doctoral level. It has its own entrance exams likeDUPGET, DURAT, BED CET that are conducted for courses like MA, PhD, and BEd, respectively. Further, the Dibrugarh University accepts entrance exams likeCAT/MAT/CMATandGATE.

Dibrugarh University admissionto courses is either entrance-based or merit-based. The University offers a variety of UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes in the streams ofHumanities & Social Sciences,Science,Commerce,Engineering,Teaching & EducationandMedical & Health Sciences.Dibrugarh Universityoffers most of the UG courses via its affiliated colleges, where admission is merit-based. The university offers PG courses through more than 10 departments and centres of the university. Admission to these courses is done by the university's in-house entrance exams such asDUPGET,DURAT, B.ED CET for MA, PhD, and B.Ed, respectively.For courses such as MBA and MTech, the university accepts valid scores ofCAT/MAT/CMATandGATE, respectively.

Admission to allDibrugarh University courses(UG, PG, diploma and others) is both merit and entrance-based. faqs.question: Is Dibrugarh University good?
faqs.answer: Dibrugarh University is approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education AICTE), NCT, and is a member of the Association of Indian Universities. faqs.question: What is the eligibility for B.Ed at Dibrugarh University?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have a minimum overall score of 50% in their undergraduate or postgraduate degree in the appropriate topic from a recognised university in addition to receiving at least 50% marks in their honours/major subject in order to be eligible for the B.Ed programme at Dibrugarh University. Even if an applicant fared well on the Common Admission Exam, they will not be admitted if they do not fulfil this requirement (CET). Hence, before applying, candidates should carefully read and comprehend the qualifying conditions.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, Dibrugarh University outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Dibrugarh University fell 50 ranks to #151 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed stability in trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Dibrugarh University's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Pharmacy' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Dibrugarh University fell 10 ranks to #53 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
In the 'State Public University' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with previous year's ranking. In 2025, Dibrugarh University fell 2 ranks to #30 rank in the 'State Public University' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Dibrugarh University: Campus and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities here are the green campus, quiet environment, free Wi-Fi for hostelers, hostel facilities, bicycle facilities to roam the university campus, library, park, museums, labs, medical facilities and many more. So the students who wish to come here could come and enjoy the university facilities and their courses.

reviews.review_heading: Dibrugarh University for engineering is good.
reviews.review_text: Library and labs are fine, not bad. Library is air conditioned. Classrooms are big and can accommodate 60 to 70 students. Hostels are average. Food there is also average. Medical facilities are also much better there. They do their work on time only.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jorhat Kendriya Mahavidyalaya.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and many more. The hostel in campus only, and they get everything in the college including canteen, rest room, gym, and more to play for mind relaxation. We have medical facilities nearby. Everything is next door.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by D.C.B. Girls CollegeReviewed on 24 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, value for the money, and everything.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing with lots of benches and a natural pond in the centre. The building is very close to nature, and the departments and classrooms are airy and good. We have an auditorium and a seminar hall for meetings and stuff. Hostel life is good too, but it's too strict, but you can always choose PG.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, facilities, etc.
reviews.review_text: On campus hostel accommodation for both boys & girls, with wardens and support staff. The common university library is accessible, it serves students, faculty and research scholars. It includes course books, reference materials, journals, etc. Several canteens & one cafeteria. A hygienic, modern double-storied cafeteria is located within the institute campus. Also, university-level canteens are shared. Food for students and staff. Wi-Fi & LAN connectivity are available. Well-furnished classrooms...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in our department were very good. There are digital classrooms, a big library, labs, and also Wi-Fi connection available in our department as well as the college. The food is also good and hygienic. Don't know much about the hostel, but the canteen is good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Sonari CollegeReviewed on 6 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I really like my college. It has good infrastructure facilities etc.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for our course was quite good. Classrooms were well maintained with projectors air conditioning and comfortable seating. The college provided Wi-Fi computer labs and a central library with a wide range of books and digital resources. Hostel facilities were decent, with spacious rooms 24/7 WiFi laundry services, and common rooms.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Tinsukia CollegeReviewed on 31 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are good. The college has digital classrooms as well. Hostel quality is also very good, including food and other facilities. Medical facilities are also provided. The canteen is good and clean. Wi-Fi works very well. The library is very big and good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Dibru CollegeReviewed on 27 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college environment, which has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are good and among the best in our locality. We have smart classrooms and a neat and clean environment. Labs are well-maintained and in good condition. The college library has a large collection of books and notes.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Dibru CollegeReviewed on 27 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am happy because of the teachers, but disappointed by the placements.

The library has a range of books. The canteen has a variety of food. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Sonari CollegeReviewed on 24 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: 1 quality education- 2 good facilities support.

Hostel facilities were decent, with regular water and electricity supply. Mess food was average but hygienic, and the canteen offered affordable meals. Medical facilities were available on campus, and there were adequate opportunities for sports, cultural activities, and debates.

Hostels seemed reasonable, and the college infrastructure was better than AEC, JEC, and other state government colleges. Giving you a good feel when you are still inside the campus.

college_info.intro:
MKU Madurai offers a wide range of courses at the UG, PG, diploma, and doctoral levels in the fields of Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology, Business Studies, Information Technology, Performing Arts, and Tamil Studies, among many others.
At the PG level, the MSc and MBA courses offered by MKU Madurai are top-rated among the students. MK University Madurai offers a two-year MSc programme in more than 15 specialisations including Genomics, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Geography, Computer Science, and Visual Communication, among others. The university also offers a two-year MBA programme in three specialisations, namely, General Management, Hospital Administration, and Tourism & Hotel Management through its Business Studies school.
Distance Education of Madurai Kamaraj University comprises the low-cost programmes offered by the university in distance mode. These programmes are very popular among students because of their easy accessibility. The university offers BA, BCom, and BSc courses at the UG level in various streams. The popular Madurai Kamaraj Distance Education PG programmes include MBA, MCA, and MSc courses.
It also offers a distance MBA programme in different specialisations including FM, HRM, Operations and Project Management, among others.

1- Application Process 2025

Those who wish to apply for multiple programmes have to apply separately online. The registration fee is different for the types of programmes applied, which are INR 300/- for non-entrance programmes and INR 800/- for entrance-based PG programmes.

For PG programmes for which entrance is necessary — 50% weightage on the entrance examination conducted by Madurai Kamaraj University and 50% weightage on UG marks up to the 5th semester. faqs.answer: No, MKU DDE does not provide a refund of fees if a student wishes to cancel or withdraw his/her admission. admission_overview.college_name: LPU Admission 2026: Dates, Fees, Eligibility & Selection Criteria

admission_overview.title: LPU Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: LPU admission 2026 is mainly entrance-based and a multi-step process starting with application followed by selection rounds, and result declaration. The Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers more than 300 degree and diploma courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels along with several distance learning courses via the LPU Centre for Distance & Online Education. The application process for the university can be completed online. LPU conducts LPUNEST as the in-house entrance and scholarship exam for its courses in fileds of Engineering, Agriculture, Management, Law, Design, Pharmacy, Architecture & Planning, and more. While LPUNEST is widely accepted by the university, if students have valid scores of other national-level entrance exams, such JEE Main Part 2, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc, they are exempted from appearing for LPUNEST for selective courses. Those who want to improve their scholarships can apply for the LPUNEST exam as well.

eligibility_selection.title: LPU Eligibility & Selection Criteria 2026
eligibility_selection.description: Lovely Professional University course admissions are decided by the scores obtained by candidates in the Lovely Professional University National Entrance and Scholarship Test or LPUNEST for short for most courses. This entrance exam is conducted for admission to more than 150 courses at the UG and PG levels. A general eligibility for courses offered by Lovely Professional University is: In case a student has valid score in other accepted exams including JEE Main/ NATA/ CAT/ MAT, etc., they can directly proceed with the remaining selection rounds.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for LPU admission?

faqs.answer: Lovely Professional University-LPU accepts several entrance exam scores. The university accepts JEE Main/ CUET UG/ CUET PG/ CAT/ MAT/ XAT/ NATA/ CLAT etc. for its UG and PG programmes. Students may also appear for the LPUNEST.
faqs.question: What are the entrance exams accepted by LPU for admission to its courses?

faqs.answer: Students should pass any of the national level entrance exams such as UCEED, NID Entrance Exam, NIFT Entrance Exam or CUET score. Those who have not qualified or appeared for any of the above entrance exams, should appear for LPUNEST. LPU conducts the National Entrance and Scholarship Test for admission to several courses. LPUNEST is computer based test of 150 minutes. The test comprises 125 questions of 500 marks.

faqs.answer: LPU NEST 2026 phase 1 exam will be conducted in January 2026. LPU NEST entrance exam 2026 will be conducted from January 10, 2026, to February 5, 2026 (remote proctored test) and from January 20, 2026, to February 5, 2026 (centre-based exam). The examination is conducted for UG and PG courses admission. LPU NEST application form is available online. Students should check the official website of Lovely Professional University to know LPU NEST dates. Submit the application form before the deadline. faqs.question: Will I get a direct admission in LPU with 65 % marks in Class 12?
faqs.answer: LPU does not offer direct admission. However, admission to few courses is merit-based.  Aspirants scoring a 65% aggregate have a good chance of getting admission in LPU. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the university to apply online. To apply for LPU, aspirants need to register for LPUNEST for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses. LPU admission to most of the courses is based on LPUNEST score. However, national-level entrance exam scores are also accepted for admission to BA LLB (Hons), MBA, BTech, etc. Candidates must complete Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. The selection rounds are followed by counselling and document verification.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What would be the fees if you take a direct admission in the LPU?
faqs.answer: The fee is same for regular and direct admission. LPU fees changes for every course. The top LPU courses along with fee details are mentioned below:Course NameTotal FeeBTechINR 4.5 lakh - INR 16 lakhMBAINR 1.6 lakh - INR 10 lakhBBAINR 3.2 lakh - 9.6 lakhBCAINR 1.5 lakh - 7.2 lakhMCAINR 1.2 lakh - 4.8 lakhNote:This information is gathered from official website and is subject to change.

faqs.question: Is LPUNEST required for LPU MCA admission?
faqs.answer: LPU accepts LPUNEST score for admission to MCA and MCA Hons courses. LPUNEST exam is conducted online every year for admission to MCA and other courses. The test is as an Entrance Test and Scholarship Test. Scholarship amount is determined by the marks and rank obtained by students in the exam. The exam duration is 2.5 hours. The test comprises 125 questions of 500 marks. Students also need to complete graduation to get admission to MCA.

placement_data.title: Lovely Professional University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package offered during LPU placements 2025 stood at INR 2.5 crore per annum and the second highest package stood at INR 1.03 crore per annum. Both packages were offered to the students of BTech Robotics & Automation batch 2025. The average salary offered to the top 25% students stood at INR 10.23 LPA. More than 2,225 recruiters visited the LPU campus and offered over 6,000 job to the students. The top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Accenture, CISCO, TCS, Capgemini, Cognizant, Autodesk, Infosys, Trident, JP Morgan, E&Y, Bosch , etc.

Earlier, the students of the BTech batch 2024 secured the highest package of INR 53 LPA . A total of 1,611 recruiters participated in the placement process and prsented over 7,400 jobs to the students. Microsoft, Google, Infosys, L&T, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS, ICICI Bank, etc were among the top recruiters.

reviews.review_heading: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.
reviews.review_text: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_heading: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.
reviews.review_text: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews.review_heading: LPU, choosing it is up to you.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists wher...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements in 2022, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university is in top-notch condition. This is the biggest university in India. All labs and library are well-equipped with air conditioning. Classrooms are well-maintained. Food is ok for South people, but it looks like somewhat difficult to survive on this food. They provide 24X7 medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing facts about Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: For my course, the facilities are quite good. The university is providing computer labs, Wi-Fi and big classrooms. The library is also there, which is very huge and consists of a wide range of books. The hostel is also decent, and the rooms are always clean. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and facilities. Good placements, campus life, and facilities are excellent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the classes are very good. Labs are also very good, and library facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi is good, but sometimes, due to the large number of students, the network goes down. Hostel facilities are very good. Mess food and canteen are also very good. Medical support is available 24x7. For sports, we have an auditorium where you can play games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: The best infrastructure this college has, alongwith very good placements.
reviews.review_text: On our campus, all facilities are very good. But sometimes we have Wi-Fi speed issues in some blocks, not in labs. The library is open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classrooms are digital for every class, we need a laptop mainly for CSE. Faculty are good. In the hostel, most of the facilities are very good, but a few times we have issues with the electricity bill at the end of the year. The gym is present inside the hostels, which is also free. The mess food is good in taste and unlimited. But the m...

reviews.review_heading: The college has beautiful infrastructure, good facilities, and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: The college had number one facilities and beautiful infrastructure. The classrooms for my course were hygienic and clean. Every block contained a library, and free Wi-Fi was available 24/7. The quality of food was not ideal for South Indian students. But overall, it was very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with excellent infrastructure and strong placement support.
reviews.review_text: B.Tech, BBA, MBA, BCA, and MCA courses are offered. Labs are available, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostel and college. The library is very good, with seven floors. Each floor can seat 100–120 students. Food is very good, and three types of food are available. South Indian, North Indian, and combined. Non-veg food is not allowed.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Lovely Institute of Technology, PharmacyReviewed on 17 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: You get placed according to your capacity and capabilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, smart classes, libraries, and even a hospital inside the campus. The campus is even bigger and has its own many areas and food courts. It has many facilities, like an indoor stadium, a pool, many grounds, and even a helipad for helicopter landing.

reviews.review_heading: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Amazed with the college infrastructure as they were offering a number of courses in various sections. For all the sections, 80 percent of seats were enrolled directly and the rest of the enrollment was through management. Fees should vary between direct admission and management quota students. Sports and games were played by us regularly as they were part of our schedule.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU  Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: Visiting the hostel rooms seriously made me feel comfortable and much more peaceful in the day to day routine. The perfect environment allowed us to have meaningful college days without any distractions. The fee fixed for all the services was not affordable to all.

paragraphs: University of Calicut has concluded its placement season though, the 2025 placement report is yet to be released. However, the NIRF Report for 2025 has been released. During University of Calicut placements 2024 a total of 282 post graduate students were placed. Out of 912 PG 2-year students 271 students secured placements. The median package offered to PG 2-year courses like MBA , MCA , etc. was INR 3 LPA . Further, a total of 11 PG 3-year students were also placed during the 2024 University of Calicut placement drive. For PG 3-year courses like Masters of surgery , MD , and others the median package stood at INR 6 LPA.

Based on the rankings from NIRF, Calicut University outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Calicut University fell 50 ranks to #151 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Calicut University fell 12 ranks to #101 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It can be seen that; in the 'State Public University' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, Calicut University climbed 5 ranks to #38 rank in the 'State Public University' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college for M. Com. course.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are wonderful for learning, however, the hostel is not worth the money due to its archaic design. The hostel features a football and cricket pitch, however, it has not been completely rebuilt. Aside from that, our college campus is spotless and organized. The facility covers around 100 acres.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Al-Ameen Engineering CollegeReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: This is a good college compared to near self-financing colleges in Palakkad.
reviews.review_text: I'm a hostel student. My home is in Malappuram. At the hostel, we have non-veg food daily, as lunch and on Sunday, only veg food. It is not bad. Hygienic food, then for a monthly fee is nearly Rs. 5000. Transportation through Pattambi, Manarkkad and Palakkad.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Farook Institute of Management StudiesReviewed on 21 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: I think it's the best college for the MBA Course.
reviews.review_text: Students at our college have access to many facilities and services. Bus service, a digital classroom, a gym, a digital library, and Wi-Fi are all available. The boys' and girls' hostels are separate. Students are provided with sports and game equipment to help them thrive in college activities. I have had no concerns with our college's infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best university for M.Com. course.
reviews.review_text: Our university infrastructure is excellent since the setting is conducive to university life. Infrastructure is likewise new, with free Wi-Fi available on campus for anyone. They also feature a vast study library and a place where students can learn new skills. There are also clinics at our university.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Al-Ameen Engineering CollegeReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Here in my college, both career and college life are awesome. I really loved it here.
reviews.review_text: About the infrastructure in my college, the hostel and canteen are neat and well-maintained. A food inspection from FSSAI was conducted a few months ago in my college. Due to these factors, the college canteen and hostel food is not bad. My college has held 8 Wi-Fi facilitated computer labs, and many entrance exams like JEE, KEAM, etc., are held in my college because of the many computer labs.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best university for the M.Com course.
reviews.review_text: The department offers classrooms with Wi-Fi, modern laboratories, and a well-stocked library. Hotels are clean with comfortable rooms. We get healthy food in the mess and clean restaurants. It also has a stadium. The campus is safe with round-the-clock security and modern facilities to support student needs and extracurricular activities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by MES College of EngineeringReviewed on 19 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The reality of MS College of Engineering, Kuttipuram.
reviews.review_text: About infrastructure, it is quite good, we have a nice library, labs, auditorium. The classes have quite good infrastructure. We have Wi-Fi in labs and separate Wi-Fi for normal usage in college, on phones, but we pay for it in 1st year, and canteens are quite okay.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by KPPM College of Teacher EducationReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for the B.Ed course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is super. The college provided both a project room and an NS room. Classrooms are good, but outdated. They lack project facilities. Additionally, a canteen and basic accommodations are available. The college can provide a small amount of extra infrastructure.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Sree Vivekananda College,EdakkaraReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)

Wi-Fi is available even in our college classrooms. In our college, athletics and other cultural pursuits are valued in addition to academics. Every year, they are honored with tremendous significance.

reviews.review_heading: 2 Years of a Blissful Life at Jaipuria Institute.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure available for our course or department are Wi-Fi, Smart TV and AC in classrooms and also a very big library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is decent and not that bad or very good, the food quality in the mess and the canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college to pursue PGDM.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is good. The hostel, classrooms, and library have a good Wi-Fi connection. Mess food quality is good. Medical facilities are good and a nurse is always available in our college. It has a good lawn to play many games. Classrooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: Joining here was my best decision.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are air-conditioned and well-furnished. The library has a lot of books, and we have a digital library also, which provides us access to various journals, magazines and newspapers. Good exposure and materials are offered.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Institute of Management, Noida.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. The library and cafeteria are the centers of attraction of the college. The college is spacious with lush green lawns. The college hostel is very big and clean and has all the amenities. The college also has an activity lounge and analytics lab.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Noida - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The college has fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi-equipped classrooms, a playground, library, incubation center, labs, cafeteria, garden, and everything that is needed. Inside the campus, there is one girl's hostel with both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms, a gym, a parlor, mess, medical facility, playroom, and laundry facilities. As of now, the boys' hostels are outside the campus, but the construction of the same inside campus has been started.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best institutions to gear up students' management education.
reviews.review_text: It provides a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus and hostel premises. The computer laboratories and classrooms are also good including the projector's facilities. There is also enough space for ventilation in the classes. The quality of life including food, transport, the general nature of the staff, and sporting facilities are way beyond description and created a friendly atmosphere for the students to be at ease with the surroundings. All in all, it is a healthy environment best suited for management ...

reviews.review_heading: This college is good for placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is excellent and it has well-equipped air-conditioned classrooms with large projectors in every classroom. The college has a very good library facility which has almost 1,00,000 books and also has a sitting facility for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college to get acquainted with management skills. It is helpful.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. It has proper classrooms with a projector in each classroom. It has a huge library with a large sitting space, books, and magazines on every subject. There is a great canteen, which provides good and hygienic food items.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in our college are qualified from IIMS and FMS.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has top infrastructure. Wi-Fi facility is also available in the hostel. The food served in the mess has the value for money. There is also a doctor available in the girls' hostel 24X7. A canteen is also available in the hostel and is available 24hrs.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college because of teaching mode.
reviews.review_text: Our college doesn't provide many facilities, but the infrastructure of the classrooms and library are well-equipped. The facilities of the hostel are good as they provide all the necessities. They provide medical facilities and also a counselor. The quality of food served in the mess and canteen is average.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with Jaipuria Institute of Management, Noida .
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provided by Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida include Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, library, canteen, hostel, garden, ground, and a students lounge. The quality of food served at the mess is fine, and it has prompt medical facilities and different sports and games for students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is really good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are really good, and we have hygienic facilities in our hostel. The canteen is good and has a healthy environment. Fresh and hygienic food is always available for us. We all feel really good.

reviews.review_heading: I am very well satisfied with the faculty members and college infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available on our campus, and they are good. The classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The campus is equipped with a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility, a 2-storeyed library with lots of books, 2 grounds, 1 canteen, badminton and basketball court and mess. Moreover, there are medical facilities, a gym, both indoor games and outdoor sports facilities, etc. Girls' hostel is available on the campus. The food served in the mess is good. Our college has followed all the Covid-19 protoco...

reviews.review_heading: I had an amazing experience with a lot of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent buildings, and all of them are in good working condition. All appliances are brand new and are very maintained. There are also green areas around the campus for students to enjoy. There is a need to add more classrooms and IT laboratories in our college. The classrooms are well-equipped and maintained. Living spaces are clean and well-maintained as per Covid-19 protocols.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection of our college is very good. We also have labs, air-conditioned classrooms, and a library. Our library is the most beautiful part of the college with a good place to sit and study. All types of books are available in the library. The hostel is very good and the quality of the food served is also very good.

college_info.college_name: Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida Scholarship Details

paragraphs: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur provides financial assistance to eligible and deserving students through scholarships. The college encourages meritorious students with several scholarships as it also enhances the college's diversity and enables them to enroll outstanding candidates from various backgrounds. Jaipuria Jaipur scholarships are provided to students under three categories, i.e. based on entrance exam scores, Sibling scholarship, and IDFC First Bank scholarship.
Category 1: The college accepts various entrance exam scores for admission to the PGDM programme.

Category 2: The college also offers a Sibling scholarship worth INR 1,00,000 to students. The scholarship will be awarded on a first come first served basis to a limited number of scholars subject to admission in PGDM/MBA courses. Further, the scholarship for the second year will be based on the academic performance of year one.

Category 3: Jaipuria Jaipur offers an IDFC First Bank MBA scholarship which is a need-based programme worth INR 2,00,000 for 2 years of full-time MBA programme. It is mainly designed for students who come from families with an annual income of less than INR 6 lakh.

college_info.intro:
IHM Kolkata was founded in 1963 as an independent organization within the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. Aspirants can receive instruction at IHM Kolkata in a variety of hospitality-related fields, including general food management, hotel management, and catering technology. IMI Calcutta's premier MBA program is the Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGDM). The AICTE has approved and the NBA has accredited the institute's PGDM program. Additionally, it has been acknowledged by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) as a degree that is comparable to an MBA. The two-year, full-time PGDM program lasts for more than six trimesters. The LBA course, Data Analytics, and Design Thinking for Rural Education are additional recently introduced courses at IMI Kolkata. Students can also apply for summer internships at IMI Kolkata. Operations Management, Marketing, Finance, Information Systems & Analytics, Strategy, Innovation & Entrepreneurship, and more are among the specializations available to students. review_content.Course: The first month at IMI Kolkata is called the orientation month. Students are welcome to the campus so that they can get accustomed to the rules and regulations and the hostel lifestyle. Preparatory classes are also taken in order to make sure students are ready when the actual course starts. IMI Kolkata is a package that contains the latest industry-oriented curriculum along with a lot of activities that are done to imbibe and sharpen managerial skills in a student. Infrastructure: The B-School is equipped with all modern facilities, including modern classrooms, a modern auditorium, and all other amenities. review_summary.college_name: Chaudhary Charan Singh University (CCSU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: They give placement, good faculty, they help, so you can go for it.

content.Placements: Not much student percentage are placed, but this year in BBA, 200 plus companies have come for interviews. If you failed, they will train you on how to sit in interviews. The highest is 8 LPA in BBA, the lowest is 2 LPA. Companies include Bajaj Finance, Agile, etc. There are more. Around 80 percent placements in BBA, B. Tech, PGDM, BCA, MBA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. Lifts are there, AC in almost every class. Teachers are also good at teaching. Labs are okay, library they have made quite good. Hostel rooms were good, food was average. Sports not happens much, games are less, only in first year happens.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Only for management students.

content.Placements: GNIOT placement is average, according to me. The average package is 2 LPA-4 LPA, and the highest package is 12 LPA. The main thing is that recruiters do not come from the big companies. The company that comes for placement is small, and almost all the students get the internships.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good and fully air-conditioned but the internet connectivity is too poor. There is a separate library and lab for each department. The college grounds are not too big but they are decent and the cafeteria is also good with a reasonable price.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Janhit Institute of Education & Information.

content.Placements: There are not many placements, but there is a small placement cell. Our course companies do not come for placements, but we get support of getting internships in schools. Almost every student has to do an internship, which is provided by the college, and it is compulsory.
content.Infrastructure: It is not so good and not so bad, but moderate for students who just have to do a degree without getting involved in any other academic activities. There is a library section in the college and a computer lab too. There are no medical facilities in the college. There is a small canteen. There are no sports and games areas, as it is just a college for those who just want a degree.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is the worst college, but one thing is good, that there is no pressure for attendance.

content.Placements: There are no placements. Even small companies do not come. Even the TCS company does not visit here. There is no competition in the tech-related field. Even the hackathon team is not selected from my college, besides students participating. It does not conduct any tour, and we will not get the college life that we hope for.
content.Infrastructure: There is a small room and three people have to live there. The mess food is worse than stall food. There is no canteen. Hostel timing for girls in the evening is only 6:00 PM. Staff and matrons are very rude and go against our character. Bathrooms are also very dirty.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: All over, good college, good infrastructure and good campus life.

content.Placements: Placement is very good for those students who studied very well, and placement is good. The highest package is 44 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The percentage of students who placed is 83%. Top recruiters include companies like Paytm, Axis Bank, EY, and all in CSE (AI). The package is high compared to the CSE core.
content.Infrastructure: There is a hostel facility. 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. A gym is available. The quality of food is not very good because it is not nutritious. The canteen meal is overall good, but the prices of canteen food are high, not too high but still high. Sports activities include cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

library.description:
Ch. Charan Singh University (Formerly Meerut University) Library was established in 1968 to serve the academic community of the university in particular and this region of the state in general.

The mission of the library is to support fully the research and educational endeavors of the students, Research Scholars and faculty of this university and its affiliated colleges, by collecting, organizing, preserving, and disseminating information in any form, by providing effective service and instructional programs, and by utilizing electronic information systems to provide access to new information products and services.

In the matter of acquisition of books our policy has been to acquire books of immediate relevance and books useful for advance level research in the subject concerned. Our aim has been to build up a rounded collection of books to meet the teaching and research requirements.

Besides acquisition against payment, the library also received great books from Central and State Government International organization and individuals.

Following types of reading materials available here in CCU: 
144339 Number of Volumes  
96796 Number of Titles
26292 Bound Volumes of Journals
10300 Number of Ph.D. Theses
108 Current Foreign Journal
196 Current Indian Journals
67000 e-books
More than 8000 UGC Infonet Online e-journals
114 e-journals
2884 e-theses

The library remains open throughout the year (except all National holidays as prescribed in the Rules) working from 8 A.M. to 12 A.M.on all working days and from 8 A.M to 8 P.M on holidays. The study room of the library remains open from 8 A.M to 4 A.M. on all working days.

And also University have membership with INFLIBNET and DELNET so all members of the library are able to access the services offered by INFLIBNET and DELNET.

The university PG courses include MSc, MBA, and MTech. The duration of all PG courses is two years and these are also offered in full-time mode. At the doctoral level, it offers PhD in specialisations such as Agricultural and allied fields such as Horticulture, Forestry, and Food Technology. Therefore, the fees for B.Tech in TNAU vary from INR 36,000 to INR 3.32 Lakhs depending on the course you select. For instance, B.Tech in Biotechnology will cost a student INR 36,000 and B.Tech in Bioinformatics will cost INR 3.32 lakhs. paragraphs: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University admissionsare based on both merit and entrance exams. Also known asTNAU, the university offers a wide range of programmes in the field of Agriculture and allied sectors. Candidates seeking admission to UG courses and belonging to the Tamil Nadu region, need to apply for counselling on the official website of the university. Those from other states have to appear for the entrance exam conducted by ICAR. In the case of postgraduate-level courses, the students are shortlisted based on GAT-B entrance exam scores and the TNAU PG entrance exam. Interested students can read the following article to know about the course, eligibility, fees, scholarships, and admission procedure of TANU.

TNAU offers a variety of undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and PhD courses across multiple specialisations through its 19 constituent colleges. Candidates willing to secure admission to TNAU courses should check out the key highlights mentioned in the table below:

TNAU course feesare inclusive of multiple components, such as admission fees, medical fees, lab fees, and more. Students are required to pay some of the components only once at the time of admission, while the remaining components are to be paid yearly/ semesterly as per the university's guidelines. The university accepts online modes of payment. Students can visit the official website of TNAU and pay the fee through its fee portal. TNAU offers a limited number of seats for its courses through the university's various. The seat intake may vary depending on the course and specialisations selected by the student. Students must participate in either the university-level counselling (for Tamil Nadu students) or through ICAR exam. Interested students can look at the following table to know about the course-wiseTNAU seat intake:
Note: This information is taken from official sources and is subjective.

The admission process forTamil Nadu Agricultural Universitystarts with filling out the application, followed by selection, counselling (if applicable), and final admission confirmation. The process mainly commences online. Interested candidates can visit the official website of TNAU to apply for the course of their choice and pay the fee for the respective courses. Aspirants can check out the step-by-stepTamil Nadu Agricultural Universityadmission processmentioned below:
Step 1: TNAU Application Process

Students belonging to Tamil Nadu can visit the official website of the university to apply for the programme of choice. Those from other states are required to register on the official website of ICAR and appear for the entrance exam conducted by the same. While filling out the application form, students must provide details, such as name, number, educational qualification, desired programme, etc.
Step 2: TNAU Selection Process

Tamil Nadu native students need not appear for any entrance exam and can directly apply for the programme of choice. Selection will be done based on academic merit, among other factors. However, for the MSc course, candidates need to clear GAT-B and fulfil of latest eligibility, i.e., a Bachelor's degree in the field of science. PhD admissions are subject to clearing ICAR JRF/SRF.
After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates are called to verify the documents. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

reviews_list.review_title: I love the college and its life here.

review_content.Placements: 85% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 52 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package is 17.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies in our course are Nutanics, 52.57 Lacs per annum, and DE Shaw, 52 LPA. 92% of students got internships in companies like DE Shaw, Hilti, UBS, Texas Instruments, Mastercard, Nvidia, TCS, Deutsche, Goldman Sachs, and Algoquant. Top roles offered are SDE roles, SWE roles, Data Analyst roles, DevOps Manager.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is a bit weak. Classrooms are clean, and the library is well-equipped. The hostel infrastructure really needs to be improved, and the mess food is fine. The sports facilities are good, and our college has its own teams that frequently participate in tournaments. College Sport events also take place.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It is a great college for opportunities with a good crowd.

review_content.Placements: More than 80 percent of students have been placed consistently in recent years. In the previous year, the highest package was 52 LPA, and the average package for the CSE branch is around 17.2 LPA. There is no clear data available on the lowest package. Mastercard, Nutanix, and Oracle are among the top recruiting companies, along with several startups. Around 60–70 percent of students get internships, while the rest are directly hired during the placement season.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are not fully up to date, but classrooms are good. For the CSE course, a new building is constructed and is still under development. But it is well-designed and maintained. Sports facilities are good. The college grounds are located just outside the hostel, so students do not face any difficulty. There are also indoor sports facilities, like a badminton court, within the college campus.

content.Placements: The majority of the students get placed, the average for the Computer Science and Engineering department is 17 LPA, and the highest is 50+, which is offered to 3-4 students only. The training and placement cell helps students and guides them to better placement opportunities. Top recruiters are De Shaw, Nvidia, Wells Fargo, etc. Around 150 students out of 220 students get internships in their 3-4th year.
content.Infrastructure: Some faculty members are quite helpful and knowledgeable, who help students for getting industry ready and gain good technical skills and soft skills. The boys' hostel is quite old, not so good, food quality is above average. Other facilities like sports, infra and all are good. COEP is the only college in Pune to have its own boat club, which is active.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: COEP is the regional underdog.

content.Placements: Offers are comparable to the top 10 NITs in CSE. The average package was 17 LPA, median was 15 LPA for 2025. This year, De Shaw hired someone at 60 LPA CTC. Other branches also have decent placement, but due to doubling the intake, the placement might be affected later. Some companies that visit are De Shaw, Nutanix, Texas Instruments, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but the number of students in the location is really low. Mess food is okay. The gym is crowded. Ground is good. Wi-Fi is provided in the entire campus, but sometimes it doesn't work. Located in the city center, so many fun activities around. The overall infrastructure is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I love the college and its life here.

content.Placements: 85% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 52 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package is 17.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies in our course are Nutanics, 52.57 Lacs per annum, and DE Shaw, 52 LPA. 92% of students got internships in companies like DE Shaw, Hilti, UBS, Texas Instruments, Mastercard, Nvidia, TCS, Deutsche, Goldman Sachs, and Algoquant. Top roles offered are SDE roles, SWE roles, Data Analyst roles, DevOps Manager.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is a bit weak. Classrooms are clean, and the library is well-equipped. The hostel infrastructure really needs to be improved, and the mess food is fine. The sports facilities are good, and our college has its own teams that frequently participate in tournaments. College Sport events also take place.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a great college for opportunities with a good crowd.

content.Placements: More than 80 percent of students have been placed consistently in recent years. In the previous year, the highest package was 52 LPA, and the average package for the CSE branch is around 17.2 LPA. There is no clear data available on the lowest package. Mastercard, Nutanix, and Oracle are among the top recruiting companies, along with several startups. Around 60–70 percent of students get internships, while the rest are directly hired during the placement season.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are not fully up to date, but classrooms are good. For the CSE course, a new building is constructed and is still under development. But it is well-designed and maintained. Sports facilities are good. The college grounds are located just outside the hostel, so students do not face any difficulty. There are also indoor sports facilities, like a badminton court, within the college campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good learning environment with friendly campus vibe .

content.Placements: Placements are decent in our course. around 70% of students get placements. The highest is about 10 to 12 LPA, the lowest is 3-4 LPA, and the average is around 5 to 6 LPA. Companies like TCS and Infosys visit for internships. They also come for roles like design intern. Around 50 to 60% of students also get internships, mostly in companies like TCS, KPIT, or some local industries. The main roles offered are trainee engineer or basic technical support roles, depending on skills.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course is quite good. Classrooms are clean, labs have the basic equipment we need, and the Wi-Fi works fine most of the time. The department has a decent library space, and faculty are supportive and knowledgeable. Hostel facilities are okay. Rooms are simple but livable. The average quality is fine, but it changes daily. Canteen food is better, and we also have basic medical help available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: COEP Technological University review.
reviews.review_text: Some faculty members are quite helpful and knowledgeable, who help students for getting industry ready and gain good technical skills and soft skills. The boys' hostel is quite old, not so good, food quality is above average. Other facilities like sports, infra and all are good. COEP is the only college in Pune to have its own boat club, which is active.

reviews.review_heading: COEP is the regional underdog.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but the number of students in the location is really low. Mess food is okay. The gym is crowded. Ground is good. Wi-Fi is provided in the entire campus, but sometimes it doesn't work. Located in the city center, so many fun activities around. The overall infrastructure is decent.

reviews.review_heading: I love the college and its life here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is a bit weak. Classrooms are clean, and the library is well-equipped. The hostel infrastructure really needs to be improved, and the mess food is fine. The sports facilities are good, and our college has its own teams that frequently participate in tournaments. College Sport events also take place.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college for opportunities with a good crowd.
reviews.review_text: Labs are not fully up to date, but classrooms are good. For the CSE course, a new building is constructed and is still under development. But it is well-designed and maintained. Sports facilities are good. The college grounds are located just outside the hostel, so students do not face any difficulty. There are also indoor sports facilities, like a badminton court, within the college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with friendly campus vibe .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is quite good. Classrooms are clean, labs have the basic equipment we need, and the Wi-Fi works fine most of the time. The department has a decent library space, and faculty are supportive and knowledgeable. Hostel facilities are okay. Rooms are simple but livable. The average quality is fine, but it changes daily. Canteen food is better, and we also have basic medical help available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in college.
reviews.review_text: It has good facilities it has some decent food quality issues but the rest is all good. The locality of the hostel is in a good area of the city with great infrastructure. I am a local so I do not know much about this but all I have heard is good.

reviews.review_heading: College is living up to its reputation with great faculty and an amazing student crowd.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is based on the old architecture of the college, but the labs and classrooms are newly developed and are well-equipped. Wi-Fi speed fluctuates, but is decent. The library may seem a bit old. The mess is average, and sometimes, on special occasions, a different menu is opted for. Overall, extracurricular activities are taken care of.

reviews.review_heading: COEP: The dream college of every student.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is a bit of an issue here. Often, there are connectivity problems. The infrastructure is good in the college. There are well-equipped libraries in the college with thousands of quality, useful books, which is good. Mess food is also okay, but in comparison with other colleges, it is very good. Sports facilities are also very good as the college is represented in every sports competition.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with the way placements are hyped by other people, as we know the reality.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides plenty of facilities. As we all know, in government colleges, most of the time, Wi-Fi is low. We can get most of the books from the library, but the seating space might be limited. It has a canteen and mess facilities, which are good and cost-friendly. It also has medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied overall because of good college infrastructure, placements, understanding seniors, etc.
reviews.review_text: Recently new meta building is built. So its more spacious now. Library, classrooms, and labs are of course on top notch. The labs and lab assistant teachers are also good. Real issue is with Wi-Fi. In most of campus area, there are a lot of network as well as Wi-Fi issues. About hostel, its not less than home. Mess food is a little messed up. But its better than other colleges' mess. There are two canteens in the college. The meta canteen is good. But both canteens are a bit suffocating.

reviews.review_heading: Helpful faculty, updated syllabus, and easy-to-clear exams make COEP a great engineering college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi network is good on the hostel campus but poor in college campus, especially in labs. There is no Wi-Fi and also no network. Food quality is very good in mess and the canteen of the hostel is poor. Sports facilities are very good. Big ground is there for COEP. Students and doctors are available in hostel. Gym facilities are also for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: College is really good. No worries about passing the exams.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available 24X7. Labs are fully equipped. Classrooms and library are excellent. Cafeterias and canteens are there on both college and hostel campus. Many fests are organized throughout the year. Students here are very exceptional. If you end up here, you will make a really good friend circle.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money and placement is 100%.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are top-notch. The classrooms are too good and a very good environment to study. We also have a sports club near the academic complex where classes happen. There is a well-furnished library with Wi-Fi all over in college with range. There are many facilities here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of College of Engineering, Pune.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are large. Classrooms have all digital services. It has 24-hour Wi-Fi, libraries, computer labs, etc. The quality of facilities is average. There are so many games in COE. Zest Fest is the largest sports event conducted in Maharashtra after IIT Bombay, so sports facilities are above average in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has very good placements in 2024 and infrastructure is also good.
reviews.review_text: In our college, labs, classrooms, and library have good structure. The seating arrangement is also very good. We have good internet access Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. College hostels are out of campus but hostel facilities are very nice. Their mess has good quality food.
