reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied because of the campus life, faculty, and services given by this university.

review_content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

review_content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
review_content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

review_content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Average opinion about the college.

review_content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

review_content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: LL.B (Hons.) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: My college's placement section must be improved.

review_content.Placements: As a student of the University of Lucknow, I would like to share that my college is better than private institutes. The percentage of students who get placed every year in my course is very high compared to private colleges. The highest package offered is 12 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, grounds, washrooms, etc. Facilities are very good according to the fees taken from students.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers of my course are very cooperative towards their students. Semester examinations are not that difficult for regular students of my college.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Noida UP Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Clinical Psychology (Honours / Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of the campus life, faculty, and services given by this university.

content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Average opinion about the college.

content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

Candidates seeking for getting admission to UG/ PG courses of the university must go through a detailedAmity University Noida admission process. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling theAmity Noida application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for theAmity University Noida feesat the time of final admission.
Interested in Amity University Noida course admissions? Check out the elaborated steps for theAmity University admission processin the following section:
Amity Noida Application Process

The Amity University admission process begins by filling an application form on the official website of Amity University Noida. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Noida.
Amity Noida Selection Process

Amity Noida admissions are both merit and entrance-based depending on the course. Students need to meet clear both criteria to get admission. The selection criteria for Amity Noida programmes are as below:
Note: The personal interview can be either video-based or in person as per the university's directions.
Amity Noida Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay for a certain amount as per theAmity University Noida fees structureto secure their seat.

reviews.review_text: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Amity School of Engineering and Technology, Amity University, NoidaReviewed on 27 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Average opinion about the college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.
reviews.review_text: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

reviews.review_heading: My college's placement section must be improved.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, grounds, washrooms, etc. Facilities are very good according to the fees taken from students.

reviews.review_heading: Great teaching staff and student diversity.
reviews.review_text: Our department has 2 labs dedicated for agricultural research. The classrooms are big enough for 50-60 students. We have a big library in our university. We have Wi-Fi facilities seperate for both students and teachers. Hostels are of good quality and the food offered in the canteen is clean and tasty. We do have a medical block and the facilities are pretty average. We have a big sports ground with equipments for various sports and games, and the quality of these equipments are good.

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty and labs, but average facilities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms can definitely use an upgrade. Some of the chairs in our class are broken. The Wi-Fi does not work all the time. The fans and their switches are a little too messed up. The library is excellent infrastructure-wise, but there are barely any books from my syllabus. The labs are extremely well-maintained and ideal for research. The quality of food, however, could use improvement. Sports and games are all great. Medical facilities are also pretty good.

There are a total of 5 meals with different foods and quantities. Overall quality of food is good. There is also a sports facility available, such as swimming, basketball, cricket, shooting, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Noida.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. 24/7 Wi-Fi facility, digital modern classrooms, and a library with thousands of books. The facilities of the hostel are also awesome. Mess and canteen food are tasty. Multiple sports complexes are present.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure facilities and friendly faculty members. Many opportunities and endless fun.

review_summary.college_name: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Horticulture - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure and labs.

content.Placements: About 20% to 25% of students get placed in my college. The average package is 2.5 LPA, the highest is 3.5 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. Companies like Reliance Industries, Amul, and others recruit from here. Internships are secured by approximately 50% of students at companies like Reliance, Amul, Syngenta, Wipro, and VNR. The skills improved include nursery business and processing business.
content.Infrastructure: Good hostel facilities, but no Wi-Fi connection. Good library facilities, with many books available. Good library infrastructure, good lighting, and good medical facilities in my university. Large sports grounds, and many agricultural tournaments are held at my university.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology.

content.Placements: This college is good in terms of studies and practical skills. The faculty members are very helpful. This college has been awarded NAAC A+ accreditation and is the first agriculture university to achieve this. Regarding co-curricular activities, they encourage students to participate and offer various internship opportunities. The highest placement this year was 10 Lacs per annum. There are 200 students in my batch.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities provided by this college are satisfactory. They have labs and take us to the fields for practical sessions. They utilize practical methods to enhance understanding. If you want to study, there’s a library open 24/7 and another library that stays open until 8 p.m. The college also has sports facilities and offers opportunities for students interested in sports. They also have Ncc; interested students can join for their personal development.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Fruit Science - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: You have to keep food items with you for midnight cravings.

content.Placements: Placement selection is not so good according to me but my experience is based on the year 2020 and before, at the at the current time, there is not much idea. As I was doing my Masters degree, graduation students got more opportunities, and now it is also accredited with ICAR.
content.Infrastructure: Nice infrastructure, but no Wi-Fi in hostels; rooms are spacious and nice; new hostels are also developed but you have to keep your eyes open to keep yourself safe from insects and reptiles; a water cooler is provided; the mess is nice and clean; and cleanliness is maintained by cleaning staff.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. and A.H.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is a great college to pursue bachelor's of veterinary science and animal husbandry course.

content.Placements: There are no campus placements in our college. Our college provides internships. Many companies visit our college for internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides the best accommodation facilities. It provides good infrastructure and facilities. The campus is green and huge. It has a stadium, canteen, etc.
content.Faculty: Our college provides the guidelines of VCI. The college pays attention to our course. Teachers are supportive. Exams are held on time and are great for evaluating our knowledge. Faculty members are top-notch.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: In the UPCATET education level is excellent.

paragraphs: IMNU admission criteria are a multi-step process. It commences with the release of the application form and concludes with seat allotment. IMNU admission process can differ from course to course. Aspirants are advised to carefully check the course-specific selection procedure. Check below the step-wise IMNU admission process:
Step 1:IMNU Online Application Process 2026

Candidates need to apply online for all courses. Before applying, aspirants must check the required qualifications for admission to the desired course. Eligible students can visit the IMNU KTR official website (srmist.edu.in) to fill out the application form. The application fee isINR 1,500for each course (as per past years' data). Moreover, the application form for the accepted entrance exams has to be filled out through the official website of the exam-conducting bodies.
Step 2: Course-wise Selection Rounds
IMNU shortlists candidates on the basis of entrance exams such as CAT and IPMAT. Candidates are required to pay the application form fee and
Step 3: Counselling & Admission Confirmation

After the selection rounds, candidates get shortlisted for the particular programmes. Shortlisted candidates are called for counselling and document verification. For the exams conducted by Nirma University, candidates have to go through the respective counselling process, candidates need to pay a course fee to confirm their admission.

IMNU fee includes multiple components such as tuition fees, registration fees, security deposit and more. Some of the components in the fee are refundable. hostel_campus.college_name: Institute of Management Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The Institute has separate hostel facilities for boys and girls. Both hostels are located on the campus. The hostel rooms are spacious and well- furnished. The hostels have sports and other recreational facilities such as cable TV and common room for interaction. All hostel rooms have Internet connectivity round the clock. The hostel mess is outsourced to a professional caterer.

library.description: The library provides access to a wide range of management and business information sources that include leading national and international business periodicals, in addition to an impressive collection of business databases, digitized corporate annual reports and CDs/ DVDs. The library has about 34000 books (including 617 E-books from Springer). The library subscribes to 14 databases and around 16,119 e-journals through databases such as EBSCOs, Business Source Complete, Academic Search Complete, JSTOR, Elsevier’s Science Direct: Business Management & Accounting Package, Emerald Management Extra and Oxford e-bundle. The library subscribes to ISI Emerging Markets Database which provides trade-related information from all over the world. The financial and economic databases subscribed to by the library are CMIE's Prowess IQ and Industry Outlook. The library also subscribes to Indiastat.com which is a socioeconomic database. The library is fully automated and accessible on the campus LAN and operates on open source software, KOHA. The user-friendly package facilitates issue and return of books online access to the catalogue, i.e. Web catalogue and reservation of books. The library has adopted the latest ICT tools like CD, DVD, multimedia kids, barcode scanners and text & graphics scanners for effective use of library services.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful life at IMNU.
reviews.review_text: High-speed Wi-Fi is available around the campus. The classrooms are very huge with great facilities like projectors, speakers, etc. Vending machines are also available near our BBA classrooms for us. We have a library named NIMA, which is very huge and spacious, with a lot of books and studying area. Hostel facilities are only there for female students in BBA. The hostel is very nice and clean. There are various hostels, H1, H2, H3, etc. NU follows a strictly vegetarian food policy. The quality ...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure for the MBA course are good enough. Wi-Fi is provided within the institute and also neat and clean. Classrooms and library are great, one big 5-floor library for all the departments and grounds for sports.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and facilities are good, with aesthetic looks.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good here, and facilities are also good. However, there are no air-conditioners in the classrooms for BBA students. Classrooms are good, and library is also well-maintained. Food in  mess and canteen is quite good. There are also good facilities for sports and games, especially for outdoor sports.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college and would definitely recommend joining.
reviews.review_text: Great hostel and college infrastructure. Being a female, the girls hostel is like a five star hotel with attached washrooms and a balcony with AC, the rooms are triple sharing and double sharing occupancy. The food at the mess is above average and they give us a variety of items every day. College infrastructure is said to be one of the finest in Gujarat.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IMBA at the Institute of Management Nirma University.
reviews.review_text: The college offers various facilities such as well-equipped classrooms, Wi-Fi, a library with e-library facilities, hostel accommodations, and mess facilities. Medical facilities are also available on campus. Additionally, there is a running track, cricket ground, badminton court, tennis court, basketball and volleyball courts, as well as a gym.

reviews.review_heading: Nirma is great at placements and events with a great academic life as well
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great, including libraries, medical facilities, buses, lounges, and canteens. Hostel facilities are available, and the hostels provide good food and a pleasant ambiance. Wi-Fi is accessible, and the sports department has all necessary equipment and spaces.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but bad faculties.
reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure as a new building has just finished construction. The mess is also very good. The faculties are not that good, and most of them have little knowledge of the subject. There are two sports grounds, one for football and one for cricket. A sports complex is also under construction.

reviews.review_heading: One of the greatest experiences with lots of great friendships and memories.
reviews.review_text:
I would say the infrastructure in Nirma was top notch; they had smart classrooms, and they had big classrooms with ACs. The campus is quite huge and lush green with all kinds of sports facilities, such as football and cricket grounds, tennis, basketball and volleyball courts, and enough lawns to host various events. 
I'd say the quality of hostels is quite good and hostel food is quite good, with them providing laundry and mess facilities and they have a doctor's clinic within the campus

reviews.review_heading: Be the best with a top university.
reviews.review_text: The campus is good, but some parts of the infrastructure require maintenance and renovation. A good amount of construction is still ongoing under Nirma University, which has multiple colleges, leading to a large crowd. The college has 22 clubs, so we don't feel alone. Wi-Fi is provided to everyone, and the classrooms and library are spacious and equipped with all necessary facilities. Hostel accommodation is compulsory for the MBA program; rooms are shared by three students and come with basic a...

reviews.review_heading: Nirma University Review - A decent experience.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-fi facility is available across the campus 24/7. All the rooms in the hostel, college classrooms, labs and library are fully air-conditioned. The infrastructure of the whole campus is decent and lush green. The quality of food in the mess is okay and at the canteens it is fairly good for the price. Nirma Health Centre provides basic medical and ambulance facilities for the students with one doctor always available on campus. For sports, basketball ground, cricket ground and badminton cour...

reviews.review_heading: A decent college for Integrated BBA course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure comprises of classrooms with Wi-Fi availability and charging port at each desk, library, computer laboratory and facilities for different sports. The hostels are good and located inside the campus alongwith decent food quality available in mess. There are 3 canteens and a clinic inside the campus. And whole campus res9nates a state of art infrastructure with great ambience.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Nirma Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our course and hostel is very good. There are a lot of facilities for the students. There are classrooms, like an amphitheater, and various courts and playgrounds. The quality of the food in the mess and the canteen is hygienic and decent.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience at Nirma.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good and well managed. There are some renovations going on as of now. There are good classrooms built like an amphitheater, and our college has a good library that contains thousands of books from India and other parts of the world. There are good canteens here with good food.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Nirma University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good here. The hostel rooms are very good and they feel like a hotel. The classrooms are good and give an amphitheater look. There are mess facilities, medical and sports facilities too. There are courts for different sports. Our college has its own medical centre.

admission_overview.college_name: Berhampur University Admission 2025: Eligibility, Fees, Dates & Selection Criteria, Application

paragraphs: Berhampur University admissionsare mainly entrance-based. The entrance exam scores accepted by the university are Common PG Entrance Test , OJEE, and GAT-B. Admission to the UG course could be merit-based.Berhampur Universityoffers programmes at the UG, PG, and doctoral-levels levels as regular and self-financed courses. The university offer courses in campus and through affilliated colleges. The courses are offered in streams including Science, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Business & Management Studies.
Berhampur University Admission: Eligibility & Selection

ForBerhampur University course admission, each course has its own eligibility criteria that candidates must comply with. However, the fulfilment of the eligibility requirement does not confirm admission. Aspirants have to complete the selection process to get a seat in the course. Check below popularBehrampur University coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

The total fee of Behrampur University includes tuition fee, exam fee, and other components. The fee is on the affordable side and starts from as low as INR 1,100. The first year fee for self-financing courses is a little higher in comparison to regular courses. Below is course-wiseBehrampur University feeand average package:

The seat intake depends on the course opted by the candidates. The university allots seats to the candidates based on their merit and availability of seats. Below is course-wise Behrampur University seat intake:
The table below shows category-wise seat reservation provided by Berhampur University:

Berhampur University course admissionis entrance-based for a majority of courses. It is also crucial that the aspirant meet the minimum eligibility criteria of the desired course. The steps involved in the admission process below:
Berhampur University Application Process

To begin the Berhampur University application process, candidates must visit its official website (www.buodisha.edu.in) and either fill the application form online or take a print from the brochure . All the details must be filled out carefully in the application. Also, students should ensure that they submit the application within the deadline. The application fee payment can be done online through the SAMS portal (www.samsodisha.gov.in).
Shortlisting of Students

Berhampur University grants admission to its UG courses based on merit. However, for most of the PG courses, admission is through the Common PG Entrance Test. For MBA and MPharm, the OJEE score is accepted by the university. Berhampur University admission to the MSc Biotechnology course is based on a GAT-B score. Candidates who are shortlisted shall be notified by the university through an intimation letter.
Counselling

The selected candidates need to take part in the Berhampur University counselling. Candidates will have to be present at the university in person with all the relevant documents and course fees. After counselling, seats shall be given to selected students.

reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is of old times. No new buildings or halls are being built even now. Wi-Fi is sucky at best only works in the library and surrounding areas with the least speed possible. There are no labs as far as I can remember. Classrooms are spacious but thats all.

reviews.review_heading: In all, I want to say my university is one of the best.
reviews.review_text: At university, you will get all types of facilities free of cost, like free Wi-Fi, labs (all types of labs), in the classroom, there is peaceful environment, and teachers give lectures. Hostel in one room, 2-person share and the bed is average, the water system is so good.

reviews.review_heading: There has been a lot of improvement in the faculty now.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, it is good. There are more courses, and the hostel is also good. The quality of food was also average at that time, but we can say that it was worth eating and it wasn't that bad.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by SR Group of Institution JhansiReviewed on 30 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is good for living the best college life.
reviews.review_text: The college is good, but there is no development. The hostel is good for boys and not for girls, due to the outer area. Labs are only for seeing and not for gaining information or for developing skills. Only a few digital classrooms are available here.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Maharani Laxmi Bai Medical CollegeReviewed on 30 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college is like any other old GMC.
reviews.review_text: Since the college is old, the infrastructure is not so good compared to the new colleges. Although labs, etc., are fully functional, the lecture theatre does not have AC or Wi-Fi. Projectors mostly don't work. Hostels are in a paramedical campus where the UG girls stay till the 3rd year, which has new and better infrastructure. But there is a frequent problem with water and electricity.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by SR Group of Institution JhansiReviewed on 21 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Placements were good in 2019, and the infrastructure is really good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my building is also very well-structured. Hostel facilities are very helpful for our daily work. The taste of hostel food is delicious, cooked with a focus on hygiene, and they always make sure to clean the room.

reviews.review_heading: It's great for studying if you are from a place with less universities and colleges.
reviews.review_text: The faculty members and infrastructure are not too bad. The Wi-Fi is always available, no matter the time. We have labs in our department and smart classrooms, but the interior is not that great either, as it is not painted properly, and desks and tables in a few classrooms are old. The hostel facility is great as per the cost they charge. You can't compare them with top colleges, but they are better than most hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very good. There are quite comfortable seats. There are smart boards in the classroom. The lab for core subjects is also well maintained. Almost all required books are available in the library.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Choudhary Digvijay Singh MahavidyalayaReviewed on 25 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the value for money, good lecturer, and infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: The college is very vast. The ground is very big. It contains a physics lab, chemistry lab, biology lab, several classrooms, etc. It has a cricket ground, volleyball ground, badminton court, and football ground. The canteen food is also worth it. The college provides good medical facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2020Offered by SR Group of Institution JhansiReviewed on 20 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The fee of the college is very nominal about Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 50,000 for those who get fee waivers.
reviews.review_text: The hostel of the college is not very good. The hostel life is not what everyone expects although I'm from Jhansi itself so I didn't join it but got to know about the hostel life. It's like a nightmare for many students, but they do have some Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: All about my university (Bundelkhand University)
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is awesome and well-maintained. A personal auditorium is there in our institute. There are 5 personal labs, in which 1 is a Cyber lab, 1 is a Ballistic lab, 1 is a Chemistry lab, and the other 2 are common practical labs. All labs are active, and the auditorium is also active for extracurricular activities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Sri Guru Harkishan Degree CollegeReviewed on 26 May 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for commerce students.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good campus, with lush green grounds, but there is no canteen facility. There are occasional sports events, basically like kho-kho. There is no Wi-Fi on the campus, it's only available for the teachers.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good that's the only reason I don't hate my department.
reviews.review_text: Labs are just fine. Some of the chemicals are expired. Library is okay. No Wi-Fi is provided you need to get your own in hostels. Mess food is just like any other, controversial. I like my department because of my teachers but there is nothing I like about my hostel other than my room.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied.
reviews.review_text: The university provides hostels for both girls and boys. There are a total 5 hostels for girls Virangna Khali Ari Bai, Samta, Annex, and OBC. Infrastructure is good. The quality of food is not that much of good. Wi-Fi isn't working. Classrooms are okay. Medical facilities are also not that good in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is okay but the department is average with no placement.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is okay if only you can adjust to their long list of rules and regulations. The girl's hostel mess is so average. In the summer, the problem we face is electricity. The hostel gate closes at 6:50 PM only and if you want to take leave, you'll have to follow a very long and unnecessary procedure.
